12.t: alakh lakhai na alakh lakhaiee ||15||
12.e: The devotees, though they behold the imperceptible Lord, yet do not disclose this to anyone.

12.g: ੧੬ : ਕਲਜੁਗ ਦੀ ਉੱਤਮਤਾਈ
12.t: 16 : kalajug dhee u'tamataiee
12.e: Superiority of the kaliyuga, in the dark age

12.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਫੇੜੈ ਸਭ ਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ।
12.t: satijug utam aakheeaai ik feRai sabh dhes dhuhelaa|
12.e: Satyuga is said to be best but in it one committed sin and the whole country suffered.

12.g: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਿਧੁੰਸੁ ਕੁਵੇਲਾ।
12.t: tretai nagaree peeReeaai dhuaapur va(n)s vidhu(n)s kuvelaa|
12.e: In treta, one did the wrong act and the whole city would suffer.  In Duapar, sinful act of one person made the whole family suffer.

12.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਇਕੇਲਾ।
12.t: kalijug sach niaau hai jo beejai so lunai ikelaa|
12.e: The justice of Kaliyuga is true because in it only he reaps who sows the evil seeds.

12.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ।
12.t: paarabraham pooran braham sabadh surat satigur gur chelaa|
12.e: Brahm is the perfect Sabdabrahm and that disciple who merges his consciousness in the Sabdabrahm is in fact Guru and the true Guru (God).

12.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ।
12.t: naam dhaan isanaan dhiraR saadhasa(n)gat mil a(n)mirat velaa|
12.e: Sabdabrahm, the Guru is attained in the holy congregation by remembering the name of the Lord in the ambrosial hours.

12.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਣਾ ਸਹਿਜ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
12.t: miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhenaa sahij suhelaa|
12.e: A mild spoken, humble and giver through his hands moves in equipoise and remains happy.

12.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ॥੧੬॥
12.t: gurmukh sukh fal neh navelaa ||16||
12.e: Ever new love of devotion to the Lord keeps the gurmukhs happy.

12.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭ : ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੰਤਰ
12.t: pauRee 17 : vaahiguroo ma(n)tar
12.e: Waheguru mantara

12.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
12.t: nira(n)kaar aakaar kar jot saroop anoop dhikhaiaa|
12.e: The formless Lord has been beholden in the form of the light (in Guru Nanak and other Gurus).

12.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
12.t: vedh kateb agocharaa vaahiguroo gur sabadh sunaiaa|
12.e: The Gurus recited Word-Guru as Vahiguru who is beyond the Vedas and Katebas (the semtic scriptures).

12.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰ ਮਜਹਬਾ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ।
12.t: chaar varan chaar majahabaa charan kaval saranaagat aaiaa|
12.e: Therefore all the four varnas and all four semitic religions have sought the shelter of the lotus feet of the Guru.

12.g: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿ ਅਪਰਸ ਜਗਿ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
12.t: paaras paras aparas jag asaT dhaat ik dhaat karaiaa|
12.e: When the Gurus in the form of Philosopher’s stone touched them, that alloy of eight metal changed into one metal (gold in the form of Sikhism).

12.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਨਿਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ।
12.t: pairee pai nivai kai haumai rog asaadh miTaiaa|
12.e: The Gurus giving them place at their feet removed their incurable malady of ego.

12.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
12.t: hukam rajaiee chalanaa gurmukh gaaddee raahu chalaiaa|
12.e: For Gurmukhs they cleared the highway of God’s will.

12.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੧੭॥
12.t: poore pooraa thaaT banaiaa ||17||
12.e: The perfect (Guru) made the perfect arrangements.

12.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਵਰਨਣ
12.t: pauRee 18 : gurmukh varanan
12.e: Gurmukh

12.g: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਏ।
12.t: ja(n)man maranahu baahare paraupakaaree jag vich aae|
12.e: Being beyond transmigration the altruists came in this world.

12.g: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਸਾਏ।
12.t: bhaau bhagat upadhes kar saadhasa(n)gat sach kha(n)dd vasaae|
12.e: Preaching loving devotion, they, through the holy congregation reside in the abode of truth.

12.g: ਮਾਨਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ।
12.t: maanasarovar param ha(n)s gurmukh sabadh surat liv laae|
12.e: Gurmukhs being swans of highest order (paramhains) keep their consciousness merged in Word, the Brahm.

12.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਚੰਦਨ ਮਹਕਾਏ।
12.t: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat afal safal cha(n)dhan mahakaae|
12.e: They are like sandal, which makes the fruitful and fruitless vegetation fragrant.

12.g: ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰ ਲੰਘਾਏ।
12.t: bhavajal a(n)dhar bohithai hoi paravaar sadhaar la(n)ghaae|
12.e: Into the world ocean they are like that vessel which takes the whole family across comfortably.

12.g: ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਏ।
12.t: lahar tara(n)g na viaapiee maiaa vich udhaas rahaae|
12.e: They remain undistributed and detached amid the waves of worldly phenomena.

12.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਹਿਜ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧੮॥
12.t: gurmukh sukh fal sahij samaae ||18||
12.e: Remaining absorbed in the equipoise is the delightful fruit if the gurmukhs.

12.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯ : ਅਜਰ ਜਰਣਾ
12.t: pauRee 19 : ajar jaranaa
12.e: To bear the unbearable

12.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
12.t: dha(n)n guroo gursikh dha(n)n aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|
12.e: The blest is disciple as well as the Guru who has made the disciple to pray before the primeval Lord.

12.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਧੰਨ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
12.t: satigur dharasan dha(n)n hai dha(n)n dhisaT gur dhiaan dharaiaa|
12.e: Blessed is the glimpse of the true Guru and that vision is also blessed one which peeps the mind concentrated upon the Guru.

12.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
12.t: dha(n)n dha(n)n satigur sabadh dha(n)n surat gur giaan sunaiaa|
12.e: The Word of the true Guru and that meditational faculty is also blessed which has made the mind sustain the true knowledge bestowed by Guru.

12.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਗੁਰ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਇਆ।
12.t: charan kaval gur dha(n)n dha(n)n dha(n)n masatak gur charanee laiaa|
12.e: Blessed are the lotus feet of the Guru along with that forehead which rests upon the feet of the Guru.

12.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਰਿਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ੍ਰ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
12.t: dha(n)n dha(n)n gur upadhes hai dha(n)n ridhaa gur ma(n)tur vasaiaa|
12.e: Auspicious is the teaching of the Guru and that heart is a blessed one wherein resides the Guru manta.

12.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਣਾਮਤੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਮੁਹਤ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਆਇਆ।
12.t: dha(n)n dha(n)n gur charanaamato dha(n)n muhat jit apio peeaaiaa|
12.e: Auspicious is the wash of Guru’s feet’s and that wisdom is also blessed one which understanding its importance has tasted that rare nectar.

12.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਾਇਆ ॥੧੯॥
12.t: gurmukh sukh fal ajar jaraiaa ||19||
12.e: This way, the gurmukhs have endured the unsustainable delight of the fruit of Guru’s Glimpse.

12.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦ : ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਮਹਿਮਾ
12.t: pauRee 20 : saadhasa(n)g mahimaa
12.e: Grandeur of the holy congregation

12.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਲਹਿਰ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਤੋਲੇ।
12.t: sukh saagar hai saadhasa(n)g sobhaa lahir tara(n)g atole|
12.e: Holy congregation is that ocean of delight in which the waves of Lord’s praise adorn it.

12.g: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਅਮੋਲੇ।
12.t: maanak motee heeriaa gur upadhes aves amole|
12.e: Myriad rubies diamonds and pearls in the form of Guru’s teachings exist in this ocean.

12.g: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਗਮ ਅਲੋਲੇ।
12.t: raag ratan anahadh dhunee sabadh surat liv agam alole|
12.e: Musicality here is like a jewel and merging their consciousness in the rhythm of the unstruck Word, the listeners listen to it with rapt attention.

12.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਲੀਆਂ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਗੋਇਲ ਗੋਲੇ।
12.t: ridh sidh nidh sabh goleeaa(n) chaar padhaarath goil gole|
12.e: Here the miraculous powers are subservient and the four ideals of life (dharm, arth, kam and moks) are servants and being transitory does not attract the attention of the people who reached this stage.

12.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਚੰਦ ਚਰਾਗ਼ਚੀ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀਚਨਿ ਝੋਲੇ।
12.t: lakh lakh cha(n)dh charaag(h)chee lakh lakh a(n)mirat peechan jhole|
12.e: Myriad means here work as lamps and myriad men getting elated quaff the nectar.

12.g: ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਲਖ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤ ਜੰਗਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਰਨਿ ਅਡੋਲੇ।
12.t: kaamadhen lakh paarijaat ja(n)gal a(n)dhar charan addole|
12.e: Myriad of wish fulfilling cows gaze delightfully in the forest of wish fulfilling trees.

12.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਬੋਲ ਅਬੋਲੇ ॥੨੦॥੧੨॥
12.t: gurmuikh sukh fal bol abole ||20||12||
12.e: In fact the pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs is ineffable.

13.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
13.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
13.e: One Oankar, the primal energy realized through the grace of divine preceptor

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧ : ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ
13.t: pauRee 1 : gur chelaa
13.e: One Oankar, the primal energy realized through the grace of divine preceptor

13.g: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦੀ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ।
13.t: peer mureedhee gaakhaRee ko viralaa jaanai|
13.e: Discipleship of the Guru is such a difficult task that only a rare one can understand it.

13.g: ਪੀਰਾ ਪੀਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰਾਂ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
13.t: peeraa peer vakhaaneeaai gur guraa(n) vakhaanai|
13.e: He, who knows it, becomes guide of spiritual guides and chief Guru of Gurus.

13.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।
13.t: gur chelaa chelaa guroo kar choj viddaanai|
13.e: In this stage the wonderful feat of becoming Guru by the disciple and vice-versa is enacted.

13.g: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੈ।
13.t: so gur soiee sikh hai jotee jot samaanai|
13.e: Externally the Sikh and Guru remain as they were, but internally, the light of the one permeates the other.

13.g: ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
13.t: eik gur ik sikh hai gur sabadh sin(j)aanai|
13.e: Becoming the Sikh of the One Guru, the disciple understands the word of the Guru.

13.g: ਮਿਹਰ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਸੁ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
13.t: mihar muhabat mel kar bhau bhaau su bhaanai ||1||
13.e: Grace of the Guru and love of the disciple meeting together in the divine order join each other in the form of the love of the Guru and fear in the mind of the disciple to create a balanced and handsome personality.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨ : ਪੀਰ ਤੋਂ ਪੀਰ ਹੋਣਾ
13.t: pauRee 2 : peer to(n) peer honaa
13.e: Making of the Guru by the Guru

13.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਪੀਰ ਪੀਰਹੁ ਕੋਈ।
13.t: gur sikhahu gursikh hai peer peerahu koiee|
13.e: By the teachings of the Guru many become disciples of the Guru, but some rare one becomes the Guru like that Guru.

13.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੋਈ।
13.t: sabadh surat chelaa guroo paramesar soiee|
13.e: Only the practitioner of the word and consciousness can attain the status of Guru-God.

13.g: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੋਈ।
13.t: dharasan dhisaT dhiaan dhar gur moorat hoiee|
13.e: Such a disciple concentrating on the philosophy of the Guru (and making it a part of daily conduct) himself becomes a likeness of Guru.

13.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਤਿਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਲੋਈ।
13.t: sabadh surat kar keeratan satisa(n)g viloiee|
13.e: Making his consciousness attentive to Word through recitation of Naam, he merges in the holy congregation.

13.g: ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਈ।
13.t: vaahiguroo gur ma(n)tr hai jap haumai khoiee|
13.e: His Guru-manta is Vahiguru, whose recitation erases egotism.

13.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਪਰੋਈ ॥੨॥
13.t: aap gavaae aap hai gun gunee paroiee ||2||
13.e: Losing egotism and merging into the qualities of the supreme Lord, he himself becomes full of qualities.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩ : ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਦਿ ਵਰਣਨ
13.t: pauRee 3 : sa(n)jogee aadh varanan
13.e: Being fortunate

13.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ।
13.t: dharasan dhisaT sa(n)jog hai bhai bhai sa(n)jogee|
13.e: He, who has the opportunity of the glimpse of the Guru, is a fortunate person well aware of the virtues of love and awe.

13.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਰੋਗੀ।
13.t: sabadh surat bairaag hai sukh sahaj arogee|
13.e: Adopting the renunciation in the form of Word consciousness, he residing in equipoise is free from all maladies.

13.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀਸਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ।
13.t: man bach karam na bharam hai jogeesar jogee|
13.e: His mind, speech and actions are not engrossed in delusions and he is king of the yogis.

13.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ।
13.t: piram piaalaa peevanaa a(n)mirat ras bhogee|
13.e: He is the quaffer of the cup of love and remains merged in the delight of nectar.

13.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪੀ ਅਪਿਓ ਅਸੋਗੀ ॥੩॥
13.t: giaan dhiaan simaran milai pee apio asogee ||3||
13.e: Drinking the elixir of knowledge, meditation and remembrance of the Lord, he has gone beyond all sorrows and sufferings.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪ : ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ
13.t: pauRee 4 : piram ras
13.e: Elixir of love

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
13.t: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras kiau aakh vakhaanai|
13.e: Quaffing the elixir of love giving fruits of delight, how could a gurmukh explain that ineffable joy?

13.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਣਾ ਓਹੁ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
13.t: sun sun aakhan aakhanaa oh saau na jaanai|
13.e: Much is said and listened to but the people remain ignorant of its real taste.

13.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਥਿ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੈ।
13.t: brahamaa bisan mahes mil kath vedh puraanai|
13.e: In the Vedas and Puranas, Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa have told enough about the delight of love.

13.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਕਤੇਬਾਂ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਦੀਨ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੈ।
13.t: chaar katebaa(n) aakheean dheen musalamaanai|
13.e: One can see the four scriptures of semitic religion in this context.

13.g: ਸੇਖਨਾਗੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਾਂਗੀਤ ਸੁਹਾਣੈ।
13.t: sekhanaag simaran karai saa(n)geet suhaanai|
13.e: Sesanag also remembers it and all musical measures also are busy in adorning it.

13.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਅਸੰਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਹੋਏ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
13.t: anahadh naadh asa(n)kh sun hoe hairaanai|
13.e: One becomes full of wonder after listening to the myriads of unstruck melodies,

13.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਪੀਲਾਏ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੪॥
13.t: akath kathaa kar net net peelaae bhaanai ||4||
13.e: But the tale of that elixir, love, is ineffable which one fortunately drinks in the will of the Lord.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ : ਤਥਾ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ
13.t: pauRee 5 : tathaa piram ras
13.e: Elixir of love

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਛਿਅ ਰਸ ਹੈਰਾਣਾ।
13.t: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras chhia ras hairaanaa|
13.e: Even the six tastes (satras) are full of wonder before the gurmukh’s delightful fruit in the form of elixir of love.

13.g: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ।
13.t: chhateeh a(n)mirat tarasadhe visamaadh viddaanaa|
13.e: Thirty six types of repasts, getting aweful before its grandeur, crave for being equal to it.

13.g: ਨਿਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਹਜਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਭੈ ਚਕਿਤ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ।
13.t: nijhar dhaar hajaar hoi bhai chakit bhulaanaa|
13.e: Even myriads of currents of delight flowing through the tenth gate become full of wonder and fear before it.

13.g: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਸੋਹੰ ਨ ਸਮਾਣਾ।
13.t: eiRaa pi(n)gulaa sukhamanaa soha(n) na samaanaa|
13.e: The taste of the recitation of Soham in the base of ira, pingala and susumna nerves is not equal to the taste of the elixir of love.

13.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜਾਉ ਚੜਿ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ।
13.t: veeh ikeeh chaRaau chaR parachaa paravaanaa|
13.e: Going beyond the animate and inanimate i.e. the whole world, the consciousness is merged in the Lord.

13.g: ਪੀਤੈ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਈ ਆਖਾਣ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੫॥
13.t: peetai bol na ha(n)ghiee aakhaan vakhaanaa ||5||
13.e: Then the situation turns out to be such that as one cannot speak while drinking, the talk of drinking of the elixir of love becomes ineffable.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬ : ਅਲਮਸਤ ਦਾ ਵਰਣਨ
13.t: pauRee 6 : alamasat dhaa varanan
13.e: Description of the delight

13.g: ਗਲੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਮੁਹੁ ਖਾਲੀ।
13.t: galee saadh na aaviee jichar muh khaalee|
13.e: So long as a tasty object enters not the mouth, mere talking about taste cannot bring any joy.

13.g: ਮੁਹੁ ਭਰਿਐ ਕਿਉਂ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਰਸ ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਲੀ।
13.t: muh bhariaai kiau(n) boleeaai ras jeebh rasaalee|
13.e: When holding the object the mouth is full of taste and tongue full of delight, how could one speak?

13.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਨਹਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ।
13.t: sabadh surat simaran ula(n)gh neh nadhar nihaalee|
13.e: Going past the stage of recitation those whose consciousness gets merged in the Word, do not see anything except the Lord.

13.g: ਪੰਥੁ ਕੁਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਅਲਮਸਤ ਖਿਆਲੀ।
13.t: pa(n)th kupa(n)th na sujhiee alamasat khiaalee|
13.e: For the people drenched in love, good or bad ways have not meaning.

13.g: ਡਗਮਗ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਢਾਲ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ।
13.t: ddagamag chaal suddaal hai gurmat niraalee|
13.e: Wobbling gait of the person full of love for the wisdom of the Guru (gurmat) looks distinctly beautiful.

13.g: ਚੜਿਆ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਲੁਕਈ ਢਕਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੁਨਾਲੀ ॥੬॥
13.t: chaRiaa cha(n)dh na lukiee ddak jot kunaalee ||6||
13.e: Now the moon emerged in the sky of heart cannot remain hidden in spite of efforts to cover its light with flour kneading basin.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭ : ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ
13.t: pauRee 7 : piram ras
13.e: Elixir of love

13.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨਾ ਲਖ ਅਗਰ ਮਿਲੰਦੇ।
13.t: lakh lakh baavan cha(n)dhanaa lakh agar mila(n)dhe|
13.e: Myriads of sandals and fragrant sticks may be mixed;

13.g: ਲਖ ਕਪੂਰ ਕਥੂਰੀਆ ਅੰਬਰ ਮਹਿਕੰਦੇ।
13.t: lakh kapoor kathooreeaa a(n)bar mahika(n)dhe|
13.e: With myriads camphor’s and musk’s the sky may be made full of fragrance;

13.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਗਉੜੇ ਮੇਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੇਸਰ ਚਮਕੰਦੇ।
13.t: lakh lakh gauRe medh mil kesar chamaka(n)dhe|
13.e: If myriads of saffron are mixed with yellow pigment of cow;

13.g: ਸਭ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਰਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
13.t: sabh suga(n)dh ralai kai aragajaa kara(n)dhe|
13.e: And of all these fragrances an incense stick is prepared;

13.g: ਲਖ ਅਰਗਜੇ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਫੁਲ ਫੁਲਵਾੜੀ ਸੰਦੇ।
13.t: lakh aragaje fulel ful fulavaaRee sa(n)dhe|
13.e: Then myriads of such sticks may be mixed with the fragrance of flowers and scents,

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਵਾਸੂ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੇ ॥੭॥
13.t: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras vaasoo na laha(n)dhe ||7||
13.e: Even then all these cannot withstand the fragrance of the elixir of love of the gurmukh.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮ : ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ
13.t: pauRee 8 : piram ras
13.e: Joy of love

13.g: ਰੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਲਖ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਪੁਰੀ ਵਸੰਦੇ।
13.t: roop saroop anoop lakh i(n)dhrapuree vasa(n)dhe|
13.e: Millions of handsome people reside in the Indrapuri;

13.g: ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਲਖ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਰਹੰਦੇ।
13.t: ra(n)g bira(n)g sura(n)g lakh baiku(n)Th raha(n)dhe|
13.e: Millions of beautiful people reside in the heaven;

13.g: ਲਖ ਜੋਬਨ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
13.t: lakh joban seegaar lakh lakh ves kara(n)dhe|
13.e: Millions of young persons wear many types of attires;

13.g: ਲਖ ਦੀਵੇ ਲਖ ਤਾਰਿਆਂ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦੇ।
13.t: lakh dheeve lakh taariaa(n) jot sooraj cha(n)dhe|
13.e: Millions are the lights of millions of lamps, stars, suns and moons;

13.g: ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਲਖ ਮਣੀ ਜਗਮਗ ਟਹਕੰਦੇ।
13.t: ratan javaahar lakh manee jagamag Tahaka(n)dhe|
13.e: Millions of lights of jewels and rubies also glitter.

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ ਜੋਤੀ ਨ ਪੁਜੰਦੇ ॥੮॥
13.t: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras jotee na puja(n)dhe ||8||
13.e: But all these lights cannot reach up to the light of the elixir of love i.e. all these lights are pale before it.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯ : ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ
13.t: pauRee 9 : piram ras
13.e: Supreme delight

13.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜੀ।
13.t: chaar padhaarath ridh sidh nidh lakh karoRee|
13.e: In all of the four ideals of life, riddhis, siddhis and myriads of treasures;

13.g: ਲਖ ਪਾਰਸ ਲਖ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤ ਲਖ ਲਖਮੀ ਜੋੜੀ।
13.t: lakh paaras lakh paarijaat lakh lakhamee joRee|
13.e: Philosopher’s stones, wish fulfilling trees and many varieties of wealth are collected;

13.g: ਲਖ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਣੁ ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਚਮੋੜੀ।
13.t: lakh chi(n)taaman kaamadhen chatura(n)g chamoRee|
13.e: Myriads of fabulous gems supposed to yield anything desired and wish fulfilling cows are also added to all this;

13.g: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਿਆ ਨਿਰਮੋਲ ਮਰੋੜੀ।
13.t: maanak motee heeriaa niramol maroRee|
13.e: Again invaluable jewels, pearls and diamonds are kept with all this;

13.g: ਲਖ ਕਵਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਮੇਰੁ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਰਾਜ ਬਹੋੜੀ।
13.t: lakh kavilaas sumer lakh lakh raaj bahoRee|
13.e: Myriads of kailas and Sumer mountains are also gathered together;

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਮੁਲੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਸੁ ਥੋੜੀ ॥੯॥
13.t: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras mul amulu su thoRee ||9||
13.e: Even then they all have no standing at all before the invaluable elixir of love of the gurmukhs.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦ : ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਦੀ ਬੂੰਦ
13.t: pauRee 10 : prem piaale dhee boo(n)dh
13.e: The drop of the cup of love

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਲਹਿਰ ਤਰੰਗਾ।
13.t: gurmukh sukh fal lakh lakh lakh lahir tara(n)gaa|
13.e: The gurmukhs identify the wave of delightful fruit among the illusionary waves of the world ocean.

13.g: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਖ ਲਹਰੀ ਅੰਗਾ।
13.t: lakh dhareeaau samaau kar lakh laharee a(n)gaa|
13.e: They bear upon their body millions of waves of worldly rivers.

13.g: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੰਗਾ।
13.t: lakh dhareeaau samu(n)dh vich lakh teerath ga(n)gaa|
13.e: Myriads of rivers are there in the ocean and likewise many are pilgrimage centres on the Ganges.

13.g: ਲਖ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਗੜਾੜ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗਾ।
13.t: lakh samu(n)dh gaRaaR vich bahu ra(n)g bira(n)gaa|
13.e: In the oceans are millions of sea of varying forms and hues.

13.g: ਲਖ ਗੜਾੜ ਤਰੰਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਅਝੁ ਕਿਣੰਗਾ।
13.t: lakh gaRaaR tara(n)g vich lakh ajh kina(n)gaa|
13.e: Such oceans may be visualized in one drop of the tears of love.

13.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਕੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੧੦॥
13.t: piram piaalaa peevanaa ko buraa na cha(n)gaa ||10||
13.e: Nothing is good or bad for the man who quaffs from the cup of love.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧ : ਬੇਅੰਤਤਾ
13.t: pauRee 11 : bea(n)tataa
13.e: The infinity

13.g: ਇਕ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
13.t: eik kavaau pasaau kar oa(n)kaar sunaiaa|
13.e: From one resonance the Oankar-Braham created the whole universe.

13.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰ ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
13.t: oa(n)kaar akaar lakh brahama(n)dd banaiaa|
13.e: The very Oankar assumed the form of millions of universes.

13.g: ਪੰਜਿ ਤਤੁ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਲਖ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਅ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ।
13.t: pa(n)j tat utapat lakh trai loa suhaiaa|
13.e: Five elements were created, myriads of productions were made and all the three worlds were adorned.

13.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰਵਰ ਸਫਲ ਦਰੀਆਵ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
13.t: jal thal gir taravar safal dhareeaav chalaiaa|
13.e: He created water, earth, mountains, trees and made the holy rivers flow.

13.g: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਲ ਤੁਲ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਇਆ।
13.t: lakh dhareeaau samaau kar til tul na tulaiaa|
13.e: He created great oceans that subsume in them myriads of rivers.

13.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਇਕ ਅਤੋਲਵੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ।
13.t: kudharat ik atolavee lekhaa na likhaiaa|
13.e: A fraction of their grandeur cannot be explained. Only nature is infinite whose expanse cannot be counted.

13.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
13.t: kudharat keem na jaaneeaai kaadhar kin paiaa ||11||
13.e: When nature is unknowable how could its creator be known?

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨ : ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਦੀ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ
13.t: pauRee 12 : prem piaale dhee ik boo(n)dh
13.e: One drop of the cup of love

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਭਾਈ।
13.t: gurmukh sukh fal prem ras abigat gat bhaiee|
13.e: Ineffable is the taste of the joy of love, which is the pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs.

13.g: ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੋ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ।
13.t: paaraavaar apaar hai ko aai na jaiee|
13.e: It’s this shore and the yonder one are beyond limits none can reach it.

13.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਵਡਾਈ।
13.t: aadh a(n)t paraja(n)t naeh paramaadh vaddaiee|
13.e: Its beginning and end are unfathomable and its grandeur is most eminent.

13.g: ਹਾਥ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਥਾਹ ਦੀ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਸਮਾਈ।
13.t: haath na pai athaeh dhee asagaeh samaiee|
13.e: It is so much that many of the oceans immerse in it yet its depth remains unknown.

13.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਬੂੰਦ ਇਕ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ।
13.t: piram piaale boo(n)dh ik kin keemat paiee|
13.e: Who could evaluate even one drop of such a cup of love.

13.g: ਅਗਮਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
13.t: agamahu agam agaadh bodh gur alakh lakhaiee ||12||
13.e: It is inaccessible and its knowledge is unfathomable, but the Guru can make one realise this imperceptible cup of love.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਦੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ
13.t: pauRee 13 : prem ras dhee ik nimakh
13.e: One moment of the joy of love

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੈ।
13.t: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras til alakh alekhai|
13.e: Even a fraction of pleasure fruit of gurmukhs in the form of joy of love is imperceptible and beyond all accounts.

13.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ।
13.t: lakh chauraaseeh joon vich jeea ja(n)t visekhai|
13.e: Many are the creatures in the eighty-four lacs of species.

13.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਦੀ ਰੋਮਾਵਲੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੈ।
13.t: sabhanaa dhee romaavalee bahu bidh bahu bhekhai|
13.e: They all have variegated colour of their trichomes.

13.g: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸਿਰ ਮੁਹੁ ਲਖ ਸਰੇਖੈ।
13.t: rom rom lakh lakh sir muh lakh sarekhai|
13.e: If to their single hair millions of heads and mouths were joined;

13.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਮੁਹਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਜੀਭੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੇਖੈ।
13.t: lakh lakh muh muh jeebh kar sun bolai dhekhai|
13.e: If such million of mouths could speak through their millions of tongues;

13.g: ਸੰਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਇਕੀਹ ਵੀਹ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨ ਨਿਮੇਖੈ ॥੧੩॥
13.t: sa(n)kh asa(n)kh ikeeh veeh samasar na nimekhai ||13||
13.e: If myriad times more the world were created, even then it cannot equal the one moment (of the delight of love).

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪ : ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕਿਕੂੰ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ?
13.t: pauRee 14 : prem ras kikoo(n) miladhaa hai ?
13.e: How is the joy of love attained?

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਮੇਲਾ।
13.t: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras hui gurusikh melaa|
13.e: After meeting the Guru i.e. after adopting the teachings of the Guru, the gurmukh receives the pleasure-fruit of the joy of love.

13.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਚਾਇ ਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ।
13.t: sabadh surat parachai kai nit neh navelaa|
13.e: The Guru merges the consciousness of the disciple into the Word and creates ever-new love for the Lord in it.

13.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜਾਉ ਚੜਿ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ।
13.t: veeh ikeeh chaRaau chaR sikh gur gur chelaa|
13.e: Thus getting above the worldliness, the disciple becomes Guru and the Guru disciple.

13.g: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਐ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
13.t: apiau peeaai ajar jarai gur sev suhelaa|
13.e: Now he quaffs the unbearable drink of the juice of love and further bears the unbearable. But all this becomes possible only through the service of the Guru

13.g: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਹਾਰਿ ਜਿਣੈ ਵਹੇਲਾ।
13.t: jeevadhiaa mar chalanaa haar jinai vahelaa|
13.e: (To attain the delight of love) One has to put to death his ego and by becoming indifferent to the world has to conquer it.

13.g: ਸਿਲ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੇਲਾ ॥੧੪॥
13.t: sil aloonee chaTanee lakh a(n)mirat pelaa ||14||
13.e: One who has licked this tasteless (unsalty) stone i.e. who has adopted the way of desireless devotion, he alone throws away myriads of delights equal to the immortalising elixirs.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫ : ਬਿਰਦ ਦੀ ਲਾਜ
13.t: pauRee 15 : biradh dhee laaj
13.e: Living up to one's natural repute

13.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਠੁ ਨ ਡੋਬਈ ਪਾਲੇ ਦੀ ਲਜੈ।
13.t: paanee kaaTh na ddobiee paale dhee lajai|
13.e: Water does not drown the wood because it lives up to its natural repute of nurturing the things (water rears up the vegetation).

13.g: ਸਿਰਿ ਕਲਵਤ੍ਰ ਧਰਾਇਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਭਜੈ।
13.t: sir kalavatr dharaikai sir chaRiaa bhajai|
13.e: It bears the vessel on its head like a saw because the vessel shears the water and moves ahead.

13.g: ਲੋਹੇ ਜੜੀਐ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਭਾਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਨ ਤਜੈ।
13.t: lohe jaReeaai bohithaa bhaar bhare na tajai|
13.e: Of course, iron is studded into the wood but water bears the burden of it also.

13.g: ਪੇਟੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਿ ਰਖਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੜਦਾ ਕਜੈ।
13.t: peTai a(n)dhar ag rakh tis paRadhaa kajai|
13.e: Water knows that its enemy fire exists in wood but still it covers up this fact and does not drown it.

13.g: ਅਗਰੈ ਡੋਬੈ ਜਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਧਜੈ।
13.t: agarai ddobai jaan kai niramolak dhajai|
13.e: The sandal wood is knowingly drowned so that it is proved to be the real sandal wood and its price may be fixed higher.

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਛਡਿ ਖਬੈ ਸਜੈ ॥੧੫॥
13.t: gurmukh maarag chalanaa chhadd khabai sajai ||15||
13.e: The way of the gurmukhs is also the same; they without the caring for the loss and the profit go on moving further and further.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬ : ਹੀਰਾ
13.t: pauRee 16 : heeraa
13.e: Diamond

13.g: ਖਾਣਿ ਉਖਣਿ ਕਢਿ ਆਣਦੇ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਹੀਰਾ।
13.t: khaan ukhan kadd aanadhe niramolak heeraa|
13.e: By digging into the mine the diamond is brought out.

13.g: ਜਉਹਰੀਆ ਹਥਿ ਆਵਦਾ ਉਇ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ।
13.t: jauhareeaa hath aavadhaa ui gahir ga(n)bheeraa|
13.e: Then it goes into the hands of serene and great jewellers.

13.g: ਮਜਲਸ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਵਜੀਰਾ।
13.t: majalas a(n)dhar dhekhadhe paatisaeh vajeeraa|
13.e: In the gatherings the kings and the ministers test and check it.

13.g: ਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਜਮਾਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਹਾ ਮਨ ਧੀਰਾ।
13.t: mul karan ajamai kai saahaa man dheeraa|
13.e: The bankers in full confidence evaluate it.

13.g: ਅਹਰਣਿ ਉਤੈ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਘਣ ਘਾਉ ਸਰੀਰਾ।
13.t: aharan utai rakh kai ghan ghaau sareeraa|
13.e: Putting it on the anvil by the strokes of hammers its body is tried for wounds.

13.g: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਹੀ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਦਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰਾ ॥੧੬॥
13.t: viralaa hee Thahiraavadhaa dharageh gur peeraa ||16||
13.e: Any rare one remains intact. Likewise any rare one reaches the court of the Guru (God) i.e. any rare one escapes the darkness of maya and its infatuations.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੭ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਚਾਲ
13.t: pauRee 17 : gurmukh chaal
13.e: The way of Gurmukhs

13.g: ਤਰਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਡੁਬਾ ਤਰੈ ਪੀ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ।
13.t: tar ddubai ddubaa tarai pee piram piaalaa|
13.e: One who quaffs the cup of love superficially drowns himself but in fact getting inebriated one who drowns in it swims it and gets across.

13.g: ਜਿਣਿ ਹਾਰੈ ਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਣੈ ਏਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਲਾ।
13.t: jin haarai haarai jinai eh gurmukh chaalaa|
13.e: This is the way of the gurmukhs that they lose while winning and losing everything they win one and all.

13.g: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ਹੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਭਰਨਾਲਾ।
13.t: maarag kha(n)dde dhaar hai bhavajal bharanaalaa|
13.e: The way into the world ocean is like a double edged sword is like a killing stone

13.g: ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ।
13.t: vaalahu nikaa aakheeaai gur pa(n)th niraalaa|
13.e: The Guru's path is unique and it's teachings are subtler even than the hair itself.

13.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਜਰੁ ਭਾਰ ਹੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਾਲਾ।
13.t: haumai bajar bhaar hai dhuramat dhuraalaa|
13.e: The disciple of the Guru loses his ego through the Gurmat

13.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਸਿਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੧੭॥
13.t: gurmat aap gavai kai sikh jai sukhaalaa ||17||
13.e: , the wisdom of the Guru and goes across this world ocean.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮ : ਬੋਹੜ ਦੇ ਫੈਲਾਉ ਵਾਂਗ ਗੁਰਸਿੱਖ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰਦੇ ਹਨ
13.t: pauRee 18 : bohaR dhe failaau vaa(n)g gursi'kh naam prachaaradhe han
13.e: Like the expansion of banyan tree of the Sikhs of the Guru spread Nam

13.g: ਧਰਤਿ ਵੜੈ ਵੜਿ ਬੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਜੜ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ।
13.t: dharat vaRai vaR beeau hoi jaR a(n)dhar ja(n)mai|
13.e: The seed enters the earth and settles in the form of root.

13.g: ਹੋਇ ਬਰੂਟਾ ਚੁਹਚੁਹਾ ਮੂਲ ਡਾਲ ਧਰੰਮੈ।
13.t: hoi barooTaa chuhachuhaa mool ddaal dhara(n)mai|
13.e: Then in the form of verdant plant it becomes stem and branches.

13.g: ਬਿਰਖ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਥਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਜਟਾ ਪਲੰਮੈ।
13.t: birakh akaar bithaar kar bahu jaTaa pala(n)mai|
13.e: Becoming tree it extends further and tangled branches hang from it.

13.g: ਜਟਾ ਲਟਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਲ ਅਗੰਮੈ।
13.t: jaTaa laTaa mil dharat vich hoi mool aga(n)mai|
13.e: These flourishing branches ultimately entering the earth again attain the form of roots.

13.g: ਛਾਂਵ ਘਣੀ ਪਤ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਫਲ ਲੱਖ ਲਖੰਮੈ।
13.t: chhaa(n)v ghanee pat sohane fal la'kh lakha(n)mai|
13.e: Now its shade becomes think and leaves appear beautiful and millions of fruits grow on it.

13.g: ਫਲ ਫਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੀਅ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਰੰਮੈ ॥੧੮॥
13.t: fal fal a(n)dhar beea bahu gursikh mara(n)mai ||18||
13.e: In each fruit remain many seeds (and this process goes on). The mystery of the Sikhs of the Guru is the same; they also like banyan tree go on spreading the name of the Lord.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯ : ਗੁਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਛ ਰੂਪ
13.t: pauRee 19 : gur birachh roop
13.e: Guru in the form of a tree

13.g: ਇਕੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਪੰਜੀਂ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ।
13.t: eik sikh dhui saadh sa(n)g pa(n)jee(n) paramesaru|
13.e: One is a Sikh, two the congregation and in five resides God.

13.g: ਨਉ ਅੰਗ ਨੀਲ ਅਨੀਲ ਸੁੰਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਮਹੇਸਰੁ।
13.t: nau a(n)g neel aneel su(n)n avataar mahesaru|
13.e: As cyphers added to one make the infinite number, likewise getting attached with Sunya (God), the creatures also transform into great men and kings of the earth.

13.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਅਸੰਖ ਸੰਖ ਮੁਕਤੈ ਮੁਕਤੇਸਰੁ।
13.t: veeh ikeeh asa(n)kh sa(n)kh mukatai mukatesaru|
13.e: In this way innumerable small and big persons also become liberated and liberators.

13.g: ਨਗਰਿ ਨਗਰਿ ਮੈ ਸਹੰਸ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਲਖੇਸਰੁ।
13.t: nagar nagar mai saha(n)s sikh dhes dhes lakhesaru|
13.e: In town after town and country after country are myriads of Sikhs.

13.g: ਇਕ ਦੂੰ ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਲਖ ਫਲ ਫਲ ਬੀਅ ਲੋਮੇਸਰੁ।
13.t: eik dhoo(n) birakhahu lakh fal fal beea lomesaru|
13.e: As millions of fruits are obtained from a tree and in those fruits remain millions of seeds (In fact the Sikhs are the fruits of the Guru-tree and in those fruits the Guru resides in the form of seeds).

13.g: ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਰਾਜੇਸੁਰਾ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੇਸਰੁ ॥੧੯॥
13.t: bhog bhugat raajesuraa jog jugat jogesar ||19||
13.e: These disciples of the Guru being enjoyers of delights are the emperors of the kings and being knower of the technique of yoga are kings of yogis.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦ : ਨਾਮੀ ਸ਼ਾਹ
13.t: pauRee 20 : naamee shaah
13.e: A wealthy banker

13.g: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸਾਹੈ।
13.t: peer mureedhaa pirahaRee vanajaare saahai|
13.e: The love between the disciples and the Guru is the same as is there between a trader and a banker.

13.g: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੈ।
13.t: saudhaa ikat haT hai sa(n)saar visaahai|
13.e: The merchandise of the name of the Lord is available only at one ship (of the Guru) and the whole world purchases there-from only.

13.g: ਕੋਈ ਵੇਚੈ ਕਉਡੀਆ ਕੋ ਦਮ ਉਗਾਹੈ।
13.t: koiee vechai kauddeeaa ko dham ugaahai|
13.e: Some of the worldly shopkeepers are selling trash whereas others are collecting money.

13.g: ਕੋਈ ਰੁਪਯੇ ਵਿਕਣੈ ਸੁਨਈਏ ਕੋ ਡਾਹੈ।
13.t: koiee rupaye vikanai sunie'ee ko ddaahai|
13.e: Some are storing the gold coins after spending rupees;

13.g: ਕੋਈ ਰਤਨ ਵਣੰਜਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹੈ।
13.t: koiee ratan vana(n)jadhaa kar sifat salaahai|
13.e: And there are some that are dealing in jewels of the eulogisation of the Lord.

13.g: ਵਣਜਿ ਸੁਪਤਾ ਸਾਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ਨਿਬਾਹੈ ॥੨੦॥
13.t: vanaj supataa saeh naal vesaahu nibaahai ||20||
13.e: Any rare honourable banker having full faith in the Lord maintains this trade.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧ : ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸ਼ਾਹ
13.t: pauRee 21 : satigur shaah
13.e: True Guru, the merchant

13.g: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ।
13.t: saudhaa ikat haT hai saahu satigur pooraa|
13.e: The perfect true Guru keeps the actual merchandise (of the name of the Lord).

13.g: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਕਣੈ ਵਚਨੈ ਦਾ ਸੂਰਾ।
13.t: aaugun lai gun vikanai vachanai dhaa sooraa|
13.e: He is that brave person who accepts the evils and upkeep’s his reputation of being giver of virtues.

13.g: ਸਫਲੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੋਵਰਨੁ ਮਨੂਰਾ।
13.t: safal karai si(n)mal birakh sovaran manooraa|
13.e: He can grow juicy fruits on silk-cotton trees and can produce gold from the iron ash.

13.g: ਵਾਸਿ ਸੁਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਉ ਹੰਸੁ ਨ ਊਰਾ।
13.t: vaas suvaas nivaas kar kaau ha(n)s na uooraa|
13.e: He infuses fragrance in the bamboo i.e. he makes egotists feel humble and makes crows no less than swans who are capable of distinguishing water from milk.

13.g: ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝੁ ਸੁਝਾਇਦਾ ਸੰਖ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੂਰਾ।
13.t: ghughoo sujh sujhaidhaa sa(n)kh motee chooraa|
13.e: He transforms owls into knowledgeable ones and dust into conches and pearls.

13.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਜੂਰਾ ॥੨੧॥
13.t: vedh katebahu baaharaa gur sabadh hajooraa ||21||
13.e: Such a Guru who is beyond the description of the Vedas and Katebas (the semitic scriptures becomes manifest by the grace of Word, the brahmn)

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੨ : ਗੁਰੋਪਮਾ
13.t: pauRee 22 : guropamaa
13.e: Praise of the Guru

13.g: ਲਖ ਉਪਮਾ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਮਾ ਨ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
13.t: lakh upamaa upamaa karai upamaa na vakhaanai|
13.e: People praise the Guru through millions of ways and to do so take help of many comparisons.

13.g: ਲਖ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਰੈ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
13.t: lakh mahimaa mahimaa karai mahimaa hairaanai|
13.e: Millions of people eulogise so much that even the eulogy feels wonder struck.

13.g: ਲਖ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਮਹਾਤਮਾ ਨ ਮਹਾਤਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ।
13.t: lakh mahaatam mahaatamaa na mahaatam jaanai|
13.e: Millions of spiritualists explain the grandeur of Guru but they do not understand the same.

13.g: ਲਖ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
13.t: lakh usatat usatat karai usatat na sin(j)aanai|
13.e: Millions of eulogisers recite praise s but they do not understand the real praise.

13.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਮੈਂ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ ॥੨੨॥
13.t: aadh purakh aadhes hai mai(n) maan nimaanai ||22||
13.e: I respectfully bow before such a primeval Lord who is the pride of the humble person like me.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੩ : ਤਥਾਚ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ
13.t: pauRee 23 : tathaach gur prataap
13.e: Praise of the Guru

13.g: ਲਖ ਮਤਿ ਲਖ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ।
13.t: lakh mat lakh budh sudh lakh lakh chaturaiee|
13.e: Millions of sects, intellects, thoughts and skills may exist;

13.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾਂ ਲਖ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
13.t: lakh lakh ukat siaanapaa(n) lakh surat samaiee|
13.e: Millions of phrases, techniques and methods of absorption into the consciousness may exist;

13.g: ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਰਾਈ।
13.t: lakh giaan dhiaan lakh lakh simaran raiee|
13.e: Millions of knowledge’s, meditations and remembrance may be there;

13.g: ਲਖ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਲਖ ਇਸ਼ਟ ਜਪ ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਕਮਾਈ।
13.t: lakh vidhiaa lakh ishaT jap ta(n)t ma(n)t kamaiee|
13.e: Millions of education’s, recitations for the objectives and tantra-mantra praxis may exist;

13.g: ਲਖ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ।
13.t: lakh bhugat lakh lakh bhagat lakh mukat milaiee|
13.e: Millions of delights, devotions and liberation’s may be mixed up,

13.g: ਜਿਉ ਤਾਰੇ ਦਿਹ ਉਗਵੈ ਆਨ੍ਹੇਰ ਗਵਾਈ।
13.t: jiau taare dheh ugavai aanher gavaiee|
13.e: But as the darkness and the stars elope when the sun rises, likewise by losing all the objects mentioned above and by becoming the dear friend of the Guru,

13.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਰਮ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
13.t: gurmukh sukh fal agam hai hoi piram sakhaiee ||23||
13.e: The gurmukh can attain the unapproachable pleasure-fruit of the Lord.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੪ : ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਹਿਮਾ
13.t: pauRee 24 : vaahiguroo mahimaa
13.e: Praises of Waheguru, the wondrous Lord

13.g: ਲਖ ਅਚਰਜ ਅਚਰਜ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਰਜ ਹੈਰਾਣਾ।
13.t: lakh acharaj acharaj hoi acharaj hairaanaa|
13.e: Beholding the wondrous Lord myriad’s of wonders become full of wonder.

13.g: ਵਿਸਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ।
13.t: visam hoi visamaadh lakh lakh choj viddaanaa|
13.e: Seeing his wonderful deeds, the elation itself becomes elated.

13.g: ਲਖ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤੀ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਭਾਣਾ।
13.t: lakh adhabhut paramadhabhutee paramadhabhut bhaanaa|
13.e: Realising his marvellous Order many uncanny arrangements feel themselves full of wonder.

13.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਬਾਣਾ।
13.t: abigat gat agaadh bodh apara(n)par baanaa|
13.e: His unmanifest position is unknowable and His form and guise is formless.

13.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਜਪਾ ਜਪਣੁ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
13.t: akath kathaa ajapaa japan net net vakhaanaa|
13.e: His tale is ineffable; unrecited recitations are performed for Him but even He is described as neti neti(not this not that).

13.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨੪॥
13.t: aadh purakh aadhes hai kudharat kurabaanaa ||24||
13.e: I salute that primal Lord and I am sacrifice unto His feats.

13.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੫ : ਛੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਮਰਣ
13.t: pauRee 25 : chhe guroo simaran
13.e: Remembering the six Gurus

13.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ।
13.t: paarabraham pooran braham gur naanak dheau|
13.e: Guru Nanak is perfect and transcendental Brahm.

13.g: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗ ਤੇ ਸਚ ਸਬਦ ਸਮੇਉ।
13.t: gur a(n)gadh gur a(n)g te sach sabadh sameau|
13.e: Guru Angad attained merger in Word by being in the company of the Guru.

13.g: ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ।
13.t: amaraa padh gur a(n)gadhahu at alakh abheau|
13.e: After Guru Angad, the imperceptible and without duality, Guru Amas Das, the bestower of immortality has flourished.

13.g: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਉ।
13.t: gur amarahu gur raam naam gat achhal achheau|
13.e: After Guru Amar Das, the forbearing and storehouse of infinite virtues, Guru Ram Das made manifest his existence.

13.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਕ ਅਰਜਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਅਰਖੇਉ।
13.t: raam rasak arajan guroo abichal arakheau|
13.e: From Guru Ram Das, Guru Arjan Dev, who absorbed one in Ram-Nam, beyond all blemishes and immovable one, was born.

13.g: ਹਰਿਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣੇਉ ॥੨੫॥
13.t: harigovi(n)dh govi(n)dh gur kaaran karaneau ||25||
13.e: Then came Guru Hargobind who is the cause of all the causes i.e. who is Gobind, the Lord himself.

14.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
Name of the true Guru is the truth, knowable only becoming gurmukh, the Guru orientated.
The holy congregation is the only place where sabad-brahm,

14.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਜਲ ਦੁਧੁ ਛਾਣੀਐ।
14.t: dharageh sach niaau jal dhudh chhaaneeaai|
14.e: The true justice is done and water is sifted from milk.
Surrender before the Guru is the safest shelter, where through service (the merit) is earned.

14.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਾਉ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਣੀਐ।
14.t: sabadh surat sun gaau a(n)dhar aaneeaai|
14.e: Here, with full attention the Word is listened to, sung and embedded in the heart.
I am sacrifice unto such a Guru who bestows honour to the humble and the lowly.
Congregation of the Sikhs of the Guru
In the congregation of the Sikhs of the Guru, the people of all the varnas assemble.

14.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਵਿਖੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਾ।
14.t: gurmukh maarag vikh a(n)t na paavanaa|
14.e: The way of the gurmukhs is difficult and its mystery cannot be understood.

14.g: ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਇਖ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਣਾ।
14.t: tul na a(n)mirat ikh keeratan gaavanaa|
14.e: Even the sweet juice of sugarcane cannot be compared with the delight of kirtan, the melodious recitation of hymns.
Here, the seeker gets all the four ideals of life i.e., dharma, arth, kam and moks.
Those who have cultivated the Word, have merged in the Lord and have liberated themselves from all the accounts.

14.g: ਸੁਝਨਿ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਵਣਾ ॥੨॥
14.t: sujhan bhoot bhavikh na aap janaavanaa ||2||
14.e: They see through all the ages and yet do not put themselves above others.
Sight of unapproachable
I bow before the eternal Lord who by his own grace shows his invisible form (in all the creatures).
He gracefully makes the unstruck melody enter into the unchiselled mind and refines it.
He, in the company of the saints, makes one drink the nectar, which otherwise is not easy to digest.
Those who have received the teachings of the perfect, remain steadfast on truth.

14.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਵੇਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ।
14.t: gurmukh bhoopat ves na viaapai maiaa|
14.e: In fact, the gurmukhs are the kings but they remain away from maya.

14.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹੇਸ਼ ਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
14.t: brahame bisan mahesh na dharasan paiaa ||3||
14.e: Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa cannot have the sight of the Lord (but the gurmukhs have the same)
Brahma,Visnu,Mahesa
Visnu incarnated ten times and established his names.

14.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ।
14.t: kar kar asur sa(n)ghaar vaadh vadhaiaa|
14.e: Destroying the demons he increased the conflicts.
Brahma thoughtfully recited the four Vedas;
But created the universe out of his ego.
Siva being engrossed in tamas always remained vexed and angry.
Only gurmukhs, the Guru orientated, forswearing their ego reach the door of liberation.
Sanak and Sukdev et al.
Even being an ascetic, Narad merely talked (of here and there).
Being a backbiter, he popularised himself only as a tell-tale.
Sanak et al. got angry when they having gone to Visnu were not allowed entry by the doorkeepers.
They forced Visnu to undergo ten incarnations and thus the peaceful life of Visnu got tormented.

14.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਕੁ ਜਣਿਆ ਮਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਾਇਆ।
14.t: jin suk janiaa mai dhukh sahaiaa|
14.e: The mother who gave birth to Sukdev was caused to suffer by him by remaining undelivered by the mother for twelve years.

14.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਖਾਇ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
14.t: gurmukh sukh fal khai ajar jaraiaa ||5||
14.e: Only gurmukhs tasting the fruit of supreme joy have endured the unendurable (name of the Lord).
The Earth

14.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਨੀਵੀਂ ਹੋਇ ਚਰਣ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ।
14.t: dharatee neevee(n) hoi charan chit laiaa|
14.e: The earth becoming lowly concentrated on the feet (of Lord).

14.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
14.t: charan kaval ras bhoi aap gavaiaa|
14.e: Being one with the joy of the lotus feet, it divested itself of the ego.

14.g: ਚਰਣ ਰੇਣੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ਇਛ ਇਛਾਇਆ।
14.t: charan ren tih loi ichh ichhaiaa|
14.e: It is that dust of the feet, which is desired by the three worlds.
Fortitude and dutifulness added to it, the contentment is the basis of all.
It, considering the way of life of every creature, offers livelihood to all.
In accordance to the divine will, it behaves like a gurmukh does.
Water

14.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਣੀਐ।
14.t: paanee dharatee vich dharat vich paaneeaai|
14.e: The water is in the earth and the earth in the water.

14.g: ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚ ਨ ਹਿਚ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਾਣੀਐ।
14.t: neechahu neech na hich niramal jaaneeaai|
14.e: Water has no hesitation in going low and lower; it is rather considered more pure.
To flow down, water bears the concussion of the gravitational force but still likes to go lower.

14.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਲੀ ਘੁਲ ਮਿਚ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੀਐ।
14.t: man melee ghul mich sabh ra(n)g maaneeaai|
14.e: It absorbs in everybody and enjoys with one and all.
Meeting once it does not go apart and hence it is acceptable in the court of the Lord.
The devoted persons (bhagats) are identified through their service (to the mankind)
Trees
The tree on the earth has their heads down towards the bottom.
They endure suffering themselves but pour happiness on the world.

14.g: ਫਲ ਦੇ ਲਾਹਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਵਟ ਵਗਾਇਆ।
14.t: fal dhe laahan bhukh vaT vagaiaa|
14.e: Even on being stoned, they offer fruits and quench our hunger.

14.g: ਛਾਵ ਘਣੀ ਬਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ।
14.t: chhaav ghanee beh sukh man parachaiaa|
14.e: Their shadow is so thick that the mind (and body) enjoys peace.
If someone cuts them, they offer to be sawed.
Rare are the persons like tree who accept the will of Lord.
Other gifts of the trees
From tree are made houses and pillars.
A tree getting sawed helps to make boat.
Then adding iron (nails) to it, it gets people float on water.
In spite of the myriads of waves of river, it takes people across.
Likewise, the Sikhs of the Guru, in love and fear of the Lord, practise the Word.
They make people follow the one Lord and get them liberated from the bondages of transmigration.
Examples of sesame seed
Sesame gets crushed in the oil press and gives oil.
The oil burns in the lamp and the darkness is dispelled.
The soot of the lamp becomes ink and the same oil reaches the ink-pot with whose help is written the Word of the Guru.

14.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
14.t: sun sikh likh likhai alekh sunaiaa|
14.e: By listening to, writing, learning and getting written the words, the imperceptible Lord is eulogised.
The gurmukhs, losing their sense of ego, practise the Word.

14.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
14.t: giaan a(n)jan liv lai sahaj samaiaa ||10||
14.e: And using the collyrium of knowledge and concentration immerses in equanimity.

14.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧ : ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਪਸ਼ੂ ਉੱਤਮ ਹੈ
14.t: pauRee 11 : manmukh naalo(n) pashoo u'tam hai
14.e: Animal is better than a Manmukh, the mind=oriented

14.g: ਦੁਧੁ ਦੇਇ ਖੜੁ ਖਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
14.t: dhudh dhei khaR khai na aap ganaiaa|
14.e: Standing into a pit they yield milk and do not pose to be counted, i.e. the animals do not have the ego.
Milk is converted into curd and the butter comes thereof.
With their dung and urine, the earth is plastered to offer worship;
But while eating variety of goods man turns them into abominable faeces, useless for any purpose.
Those who have worshipped Lord in the holy congregation, their life is blessed and successful.

14.g: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
14.t: safal janam jag aai sukh fal paiaa ||11||
14.e: Only they get the fruit of life on earth.

14.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਕਪਾਹ ਵਾਂਗ ਕਸ਼ਟ ਸਹਾਰਦੇ ਹਨ
14.t: pauRee 12 : gurmukh kapaeh vaa(n)g kashaT sahaaradhe han
14.e: Gurmukhs tolerate sufferings like cotton
Accepting the will of the Lord, cotton suffers a lot.
Having been ginned through the roller, it is carded.
Having carded it, its yarn is spun.
Then the weaver with the help of his reed, eaves it into cloth.
The washerman puts that cloth into his boiling cauldron and then washes it on a stream.
Putting on the same clothes, the rich and the kings adorn the assemblies.

14.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਜੀਠ ਤੇ ਕਮਾਦ ਵਾਂਗ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੋਂ ਮੂੰਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਮੋੜਦੇ
14.t: pauRee 13 : gurmukh majeeTh te kamaadh vaa(n)g sevaa to(n) moo(n)h nahee(n) moRadhe
14.e: Gurmukhs keep busy in service
Madder (Rubia munjista) knowing very well gets itself grinded.

14.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛਡੈ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
14.t: kadhe na chhaddai sa(n)g banat banaiaa|
14.e: Its character is such that it never deserts the clothes.
Likewise, the sugarcane also care freely gets itself crushed.

14.g: ਕਰੈ ਨ ਮਨ ਰਸ ਭੰਗੁ ਅਮਿਓ ਚੁਆਇਆ।
14.t: karai na man ras bha(n)g amio chuaaiaa|
14.e: Without leaving away its sweetness offers the taste of nectar.

14.g: ਗੁੜੁ ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡ ਅਚੰਗੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਾਇਆ।
14.t: guR sakar kha(n)dd acha(n)g bhog bhugaiaa|
14.e: It produces jaggery, sugar, treacle molasses many relishable items.

14.g: ਸਾਧ ਨ ਮੋੜਨ ਅੰਗੁ ਜਗੁ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
14.t: saadh na moRan a(n)g jag parachaiaa ||13||
14.e: Similarly, the saints also do not abstain from the service of mankind, and give happiness to all.

14.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪ : ਲੋਹੇ ਵਾਂਗ ਆਪਾ ਭਾਵ ਗਵਾ ਕੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਾ ਦੇਖੀਦਾ ਹੈ
14.t: pauRee 14 : lohe vaa(n)g aapaa bhaav gavaa ke hee aapaa dhekheedhaa hai
14.e: By deleting of ego, like iron, one sees the self
Putting iron into the furnance the iron is heated.
Then it is put on the anvil where it bears the strokes of hammer.
Making it clear like glass, its value is set.
Grinding against whet stones its parts are pruned i.e. many articles are made out of it.
Now keeping it (or those articles) in the saw-dust etc. it is left for getting clean.
Similarly the gurmukhs by losing their ego come face to face with their own basic nature.

14.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫ : ਰਬਾਬ ਵਾਂਗ ਦੁੱਖ ਸਹਾਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਹਿਜ ਪਦ ਵਿਚ ਸਮਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ
14.t: pauRee 15 : rabaab vaa(n)g dhu'kh sahaar ke gurmukh sahij padh vich samaau(n)dhe han
14.e: Example of rebeck
A handsome tree got cut itself and got manufactured into a rebeck.
A young goat underwent the mortification of getting killed itself; it distributed its meat among the meat-eaters.
Its intestines were made into gut and the skin was mounted (on drum) and stitched.
Now it is brought in the holy congregation where melody is produced on this instrument.
It creates the melody of Raag as the Shabad is heard.
Any one who worships true Guru, the God, gets absorbed into the equanimity.
Sandal tree

14.g: ਚੰਨਣੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਰਖਿਆ।
14.t: cha(n)nan rukh upai van kha(n)dd rakhiaa|
14.e: God created the sandal tree and kept it in the forest.

14.g: ਪਵਣੁ ਗਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ।
14.t: pavan gavan kar jai alakh na lakhiaa|
14.e: The breeze moves around the sandal but does not understand the imperceptible (nature of the tree).
The truth about the sandal comes to the forefront when it perfumes everyone with its fragrance.
The gurmukh goes beyond all the caste and the distinctions of eating taboos.

14.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀ ਚਖਿਆ।
14.t: saadhasa(n)gat bhai bhai apiau pee chakhiaa|
14.e: He drinks the nectar of fear and love of the Lord in the holy congregation.
The Gurmukh comes face to face with his own intrinsic nature (sahaj subhai).
Service of the Gursikh
Within the teaching of the Guru, the Sikhs of the Guru serve (others).
They give in charity the four riches (char padarathi) to the beggars.
They sing paeans of the invisible Lord who is beyond all accounts.

14.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸ ਇਖ ਅਮਿਉ ਚੁਆਵਣੀ।
14.t: bhai bhagat ras ikh amiau chuaavanee|
14.e: They drink the juice of the sugarcane of loving devotion, and make others also enjoy the same.

14.g: ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣੀ।
14.t: tul na bhoot bhavikh na keemat paavanee|
14.e: Nothing in the past as well as the future can be equal to their love.

14.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਵਿਖ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣੀ ॥੧੭॥
14.t: gurmukh maarag vikh lavai na laavanee ||17||
14.e: None can vie with even the one step of the way of gurmukhs.

14.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮ : ਗੁਰਸਿੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦਾ ਫਲ
14.t: pauRee 18 : gursi'khaa(n) dhee sevaa dhaa fal
14.e: Fruits of the service of Gursikhs

14.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਲਖ ਰਾਜ ਨੀਰ ਭਰਾਵਣੀ।
14.t: ei(n)dhr puree lakh raaj neer bharaavanee|
14.e: Fetching water for the holy congregation is equal to the kingdom of lacs of Indrapuris.
Grinding of corn (for the holy congregation) is more than the pleasure of myriads of heavens.

14.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਲਖ ਸਾਜ ਚੁਲਿ ਝੁਕਾਵਣੀ।
14.t: ridh sidh nidh lakh saaj chul jhukaavanee|
14.e: Arranging for and putting in woods into the hearth of langar (free kitchen) for the congregation is equal to the rddhis, siddhis and the nine treasures.
The holy persons are the caretakers of the poor and in their company the humility resides in the heart (of people).
Singing of hymns of the Guru is the personification of the unstruck melody.
Fruits of the service

14.g: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਲਖ ਭੋਗ ਚਣੇ ਚਬਾਵਣੀ।
14.t: hom jag lakh bhog chane chabaavanee|
14.e: To feed a Sikh with parched gram is superior to hundreds of thousands of burnt offerings and feasts.
To cause his to be washed is superior to visits to assemblages at the places of pilgrimages.

14.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਖ ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਣਾਵਣੀ।
14.t: giaan dhiaan lakh jog sabadh sunaavanee|
14.e: To repeat to a Sikh of the Gurus hymns is equal to a hundred thousands of other religious exercises.

14.g: ਰਹੈ ਨ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗ ਝਾਤੀ ਪਾਵਣੀ।
14.t: rahai na sahasaa sog jhaatee paavanee|
14.e: Even the glimpse of the Guru dispels all doubts and regrets.

14.g: ਭਉਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਰੋਗ ਨ ਲਹਰਿ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ।
14.t: bhaujal vich arog na lahar ddaraavanee|
14.e: Such a man remains unscathed in the terrible world ocean and does not fear its waves.
He whom embraces the Gurus religion (Gurmati) has past beyond the bounds of joy or grief for gain or loss.
Infinite Fruits of service
As the seed puts in the earth gives fruit thousand times more.

14.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਵਾਇ ਨ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ।
14.t: gursikh mukh pavai na lekh likhaiaa|
14.e: The food put in the mouth of a gurmukh multiplies infinitely and its count becomes impossible.

14.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਫਲਾਇ ਜੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
14.t: dharatee dhei falai joiee fal paiaa|
14.e: The earth gives the fruit of the seed sowed in it;

14.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਲਾਇਆ।
14.t: gursikh mukh samai sabh fal laiaa|
14.e: But the seed it offered to Guru oriented ones gives all sorts of fruits.

14.g: ਬੀਜੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ਨ ਧਰਤਿ ਜਮਾਇਆ।
14.t: beeje baajh na khai na dharat jamaiaa|
14.e: Without sowing, neither anyone could eat anything nor the earth can produce anything;
Having the desire of serve the Gurmukh, fulfils all desires.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧ : ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ
15.t: pauRee 1 : satigur mahimaa
15.e: Vaar 15

15.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
15.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||
15.e: One Oankar, the primal energy realised through the grace of divine preceptor

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਕੂੜੇ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਦੁਨੀਆਵੇ।
15.t: satigur sachaa paatisaahu kooRe baadhisaeh dhuneeaave|
15.e: The true Guru (God) is the true emperor; all other worldly kinds are fake ones.

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਨਉਂ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ।
15.t: satigur naathaa naath hai hoi nau(n) naath anaath nithaave|
15.e: The true Guru is the Lord of lords; the nine naths (members and heads of ascetic yogi orders) are refugeless and without any master.

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਪਾਛਾਵੇ।
15.t: satigur sach dhaataar hai hor dhaate firadhe paachhaave|
15.e: The true Guru is the true bestower; other donors just move after Him.

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਨਿਨਾਵਨਿ ਨਾਵੇ।
15.t: satigur karataa purakh hai kar karatoot ninaavan naave|
15.e: The true Guru is the creator and makes the unknown famous by giving them the name (naam).

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਾਹ ਅਵੇਸਾਹ ਉਚਾਵੇ।
15.t: satigur sachaa saahu hai hor saeh avesaeh uchaave|
15.e: True Guru is the real banker; other rich person’s cannot be believed.

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਵੈਦੁ ਸਭ ਕੈਦ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ।
15.t: satigur sachaa vaidh hai hor vaidh sabh kaidh kooRaave|
15.e: The true Guru is the true physician; others themselves are imprisoned in the false bondage of transmigration.

15.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਗੋਸਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
15.t: vin satigur sabh nigosaavai ||1||
15.e: Without the true Guru they all are without the guiding force.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੨ : ਓਹੋ ਹੀ
15.t: pauRee 2 : oho hee
15.e: Praise of the true Guru

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ।
15.t: satigur teerath jaaneeaai aThasaTh teerath saranee aae|
15.e: The true Guru is that pilgrimages centre in whose shelter are the sixty-eight pilgrimage centres of the Hindus.

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਉ ਅਭੇਉ ਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਦੇਵ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵ ਤਰਾਏ।
15.t: satigur dheau abheau hai hor dhev gur sev taraae|
15.e: Being beyond dualities, the true a Guru is the supreme God and other gods get across the world ocean only by serving Him.

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਲਖ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਸੁਹਾਏ।
15.t: satigur paaras parasiaai lakh paaras paa khaak suhaae|
15.e: The true Guru is that philosopher's stone the dust of whose feet adorns millions of philosopher's stones.

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਲਖ ਸਫਲ ਧਿਆਏ।
15.t: satigur pooraa paarijaat paarajaat lakh safal dhiaae|
15.e: The true Guru is that perfect wish-fulfilling tree who is meditated upon by the millions of wish-fulfilling trees.

15.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਏ।
15.t: sukh saagar satigur purakh ratan padhaarath sikh sunaae|
15.e: The true Guru being ocean of delights distributes pearls in the form of different sermons.

15.g: ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣੀ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਕਰਾਏ।
15.t: chi(n)taaman satigur charan chi(n)taamanee achi(n)t karaae|
15.e: The feet of the true Guru are that desire fulfilling fabulous gem (chintamani) which makes myriads of gems free of anxieties.

15.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
15.t: vin satigur sabh dhoojai bhaae ||2||
15.e: Except the true Guru (God) all other is duality (which makes one go the cycle of transmigration).

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੩ : ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਦੀ ਉਤਪੱਤੀ
15.t: pauRee 3 : maanas dheh dhee utapa'tee
15.e: Origin of the Human body

15.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਜੂਨਿ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ।
15.t: lakh chauraaseeh joon vich utam joon su maanas dhehee|
15.e: Out of the eighty-four lakh species, the human life is the best one.

15.g: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਦੇਹੀ।
15.t: akhee dhekhai nadhar kar jihabaa bolai bachan bidhehee|
15.e: By his eyes man beholds and with his tongue he eulogises God.

15.g: ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਾਸ ਲਏ ਨਕਿ ਸਾਸ ਸਨੇਹੀ।
15.t: ka(n)nee sunadhaa surat kar vaas le nak saas sanehee|
15.e: By ears he listens carefully and smells lovingly by his nose.

15.g: ਹਥੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਇਵੇਹੀ।
15.t: hathee kirat kamaavanee pairee chalan jot ivehee|
15.e: By hands he earns livelihood and moves by the power of feet.

15.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ।
15.t: gurmukh janam sakaarathaa manmukh moorat mat kinehee|
15.e: In this species, the life of a gurmukh is successful but how is the thinking of manmukh, the mind-orientated one ? The thinking of the manmukh is evil.

15.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਧਰੇਹੀ।
15.t: karataa purakh visaar kai maanas dhee man aas dharehee|
15.e: Manmukh, forgetting the Lord goes on pinning his hopes upon men.

15.g: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਬੁਰੀ ਹੁਰੇਹੀ ॥੩॥
15.t: pasoo paretahu buree hurehee ||3||
15.e: His body is worse than then animals’ and the ghosts’.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੪ : ਬੰਦੇ ਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੀ ਦਸ਼ਾ
15.t: pauRee 4 : ba(n)dhe dhaa ba(n)dhaa manmukh dhee dhashaa
15.e: Slave of the man; the position of the manmukh  ,

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਬੰਦੇ ਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ।
15.t: satigur saahib chhadd kai manmukh hoi ba(n)dhe dhaa ba(n)dhaa|
15.e: Manmukh, the mind-orientated, leaving away the true Guru Lord becomes slave of man.

15.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਲਾਮ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
15.t: hukamee ba(n)dhaa hoi kai nit uTh jai salaam kara(n)dhaa|
15.e: Becoming errand boy of man he goes daily to salute him.

15.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਖੜਾ ਰਹੰਦਾ।
15.t: aaTh pahar hath joR kai hoi hazooree khaRaa raha(n)dhaa|
15.e: All the twenty four hours (eight pahars) with folded hands he stands before his master.

15.g: ਨੀਦ ਨ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਸੁਖ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੂਲੀ ਚੜੑਹਿਆ ਰਹੈ ਡਰੰਦਾ।
15.t: needh na bhukh na sukh tis soolee chaR(h)hiaa rahai ddara(n)dhaa|
15.e: Sleep, hunger and pleasure he does not have and remains so scared as if he has been sacrificed.

15.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਧੁਪ ਛਾਉ ਸਿਰ ਉਤੈ ਝਲਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਦਾ।
15.t: paanee paalaa dhup chhaau sir utai jhal dhukh saha(n)dhaa|
15.e: Throughout rains, cold, sunlight, shade, he undergoes myriad sufferings.

15.g: ਆਤਸਬਾਜੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਰਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਘਾਇਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਰੰਦਾ।
15.t: aatasabaajee saar vekh ran vich ghail hoi mara(n)dhaa|
15.e: In the battlefield (of life) this same person, considering sparks of iron as fireworks gets mortally wounded.

15.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੂਨਿ ਭਵੰਦਾ ॥੪॥
15.t: gur poore vin joon bhava(n)dhaa ||4||
15.e: Without the (shelter of) perfect Guru, he wanders through the species.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ : ਕੰਨ ਪਾਟਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਹਾਲ
15.t: pauRee 5 : ka(n)n paaTiaa(n) dhaa haal
15.e: Condition of the split-ears-

15.g: ਨਾਥਾਂ ਨਾਥੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ।
15.t: naathaa(n) naath na sevanee hoi anaath guroo bahu chele|
15.e: Not serving the Lord (God) of Lords, many lords (naths) becoming gurus initiate people as their disciples.

15.g: ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਪਰੁ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇਲੇ।
15.t: ka(n)n paRai bibhoot lai khi(n)thaa khapar dda(n)ddaa hele|
15.e: They getting the ears split and applying ashes on their bodies carry begging bowls and staff.

15.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਟੁਕਰ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਾਜਾਇਨਿ ਭੇਲੇ।
15.t: ghar ghar Tukar ma(n)gadhe si(n)n(g)ee naadh vaajain bhele|
15.e: Going from door to door, they beg food and blow their singi, a special instrument made of horn.

15.g: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਵਰਾਤੀ ਮੇਲੇ।
15.t: bhugat piaalaa va(n)ddeeaai sidh saadhik sivaraatee mele|
15.e: Getting together on the Sivaratri fair they share with one another the food and the cup of drinks.

15.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਚਲਾਇਦੇ ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟੀ ਖਰੇ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ।
15.t: baareh pa(n)th chalaidhe baareh vaaTee khare dhuhele|
15.e: They follow one of the twelve sects (of yogis) and go on moving on these twelve ways i.e. they go on transmigrating.

15.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਸਿਝਨੀ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲੇ।
15.t: vin gur sabadh na sijhanee baajeegar kar baajee khele|
15.e: Without the word of the Guru, none gets liberated and all of them run here and there like acrobats.

15.g: ਅੰਨ੍ਹੈ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਖੂਹੀ ਠੇਲੇ ॥੫॥
15.t: a(n)nhai a(n)nhaa khoohee Thele ||5||
15.e: This way the blind one goes on pushing the blind into the well.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੬ : ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝ ਰੋਣਾ ਹੀ ਰੋਣਾ
15.t: pauRee 6 : poore guroo baajh ronaa hee ronaa
15.e: Weeping and wailing without the perfect Guru

15.g: ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਰ ਕੈ ਮੰਗਤਿਆਂ ਨੋ ਮੰਗਣ ਜਾਹੀ।
15.t: sach dhaataar visaar kai ma(n)gatiaa(n) no ma(n)gan jaahee|
15.e: Forgetting the true bestower, people spread their hands before the beggars.

15.g: ਢਾਢੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ ਗਾਂਵਦੇ ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਜੋਧ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ।
15.t: ddaaddee vaaraa(n) gaa(n)vadhe vair virodh jodh saalaahee|
15.e: The bards sing of the brave works pertaining to the brave and eulogise the duels and enmities of the warriors.

15.g: ਨਾਈ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੱਦੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਦਰਾਹੀ।
15.t: naiee gaavan sa'dhaRe kar karatoot mue badharaahee|
15.e: The barbers also sing the praises of those who have died treading evil path and committing evil deeds.

15.g: ਪੜਦੇ ਭਟ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਕੂੜ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਮੁਖਹਿ ਅਲਾਹੀ।
15.t: paRadhe bhaT kavit kar kooR kusat mukheh alaahee|
15.e: The eulogisers recite poetry for false kings and go on telling lies.

15.g: ਹੋਇ ਅਸਿਰਿਤ ਪੁਰੋਹਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਰੀਤੈ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਮੰਗਾਹੀ।
15.t: hoi asirit purohitaa preet pareetai virat ma(n)gaahee|
15.e: The priests first seek shelter but afterwards lay their claim of bread and butter i.e. they entangle people in the fear of the net of ritualism.

15.g: ਛੁਰੀਆ ਮਾਰਨਿ ਪੰਖੀਏ ਹਟਿ ਹਟਿ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਭਿਖ ਭਵਾਹੀ।
15.t: chhureeaa maaran pa(n)khe'ee haT haT ma(n)gadhe bhikh bhavaahee|
15.e: The people belonging to the sects of persons wearing feathers on their heads punch their bodies with knives and go on begging from shop to shop.

15.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਧਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
15.t: gur poore vin rovan dhaahee ||6||
15.e: But without the perfect Guru, they all wail and weep bitterly.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੭ : ਝੂਠੇ ਸਾਕ
15.t: pauRee 7 : jhooThe saak
15.e: The fake relations

15.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਕੀਤੇ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ।
15.t: karataa purakh na chetio keete no karataa kar jaanai|
15.e: O man, you have not remembered the creator and have accepted the created as your creator.

15.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਭਤਾਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤੁ ਪੋਤਾ ਪਿਉ ਦਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
15.t: naar bhataar piaar kar put potaa piau dhaadh vakhaanai|
15.e: Getting engrossed in wife or husband you have further created relationships of son, grandson, father and grandfather.

15.g: ਧੀਆ ਭੈਣਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਸਨਿ ਰੁਸਨਿ ਸਾਕ ਬਬਾਣੈ।
15.t: dheeaa bhainaa maan kar tusan rusan saak babaanai|
15.e: Daughters and sisters proudly become happy or annoyed and such is the case of all relatives.

15.g: ਸਾਹੁਰ ਪੀਹਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੇ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
15.t: saahur peehar naanake paravaarai saadhaar dhin(g)aanai|
15.e: All other relation's such as the house of father-in-law, one's mother's house, the house of the maternal uncles and other relations of the family are disdainful.

15.g: ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੰਚਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
15.t: chaj achaar veechaar vich pa(n)chaa a(n)dhar pat paravaanai|
15.e: If conduct and thoughts are civilised, one gets honour before the high ups of the society.

15.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
15.t: a(n)t kaal jam jaal vich saathee koi na hoi sin(j)aanai|
15.e: However, at the end, when caught up in the web of death, no companion takes notice of the person.

15.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਜਾਇ ਜਮਾਣੈ ॥੭॥
15.t: gur poore vin jai jamaanai ||7||
15.e: Bereft of the grace of the perfect Guru, all persons become scared of death.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੮ : ਝੂਠੇ ਵਪਾਰੀ
15.t: pauRee 8 : jhooThe vapaaree
15.e: False merchants

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਕੂੜੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ।
15.t: satigur saahu athaahu chhadd kooRe saahu kooRe vanajaare|
15.e: Except the infinite true Guru all other bankers and traders are false.

15.g: ਸਉਦਾਗਰ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਵਣਜ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੇ।
15.t: saudhaagar saudhaagaree ghoRe vanaj karan at bhaare|
15.e: The merchants trade heavily in horses.

15.g: ਰਤਨਾ ਪਰਖ ਜਵਾਹਰੀ ਹੀਰੇ ਮਾਣਕ ਵਣਜ ਪਸਾਰੇ।
15.t: ratanaa parakh javaaharee heere maanak vanaj pasaare|
15.e: The jewellers test the jewels and through diamonds and rubies spread their business.

15.g: ਹੋਇ ਸਰਾਫ ਬਜਾਜ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਭਾਰੇ।
15.t: hoi saraaf bajaaj bahu suinaa rupaa kapaR bhaare|
15.e: Gold merchants deal in gold and cash and drapers deal in clothes.

15.g: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਜ ਲੁਣਨਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਵਿਸਥਾਰੇ।
15.t: kirasaanee kirasaan kar beej lunan bohal visathaare|
15.e: Farmers undertake farming and sowing seed cut it afterwards and makes it big heaps.

15.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਤੋਟਾ ਵਰੁ ਸਰਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ।
15.t: laahaa toTaa var saraap kar sa(n)jog vijog vichaare|
15.e: In all this business, profit, loss, boon, cure, meeting, separation goes hand in hand.

15.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ ॥੮॥
15.t: gur poore vin dhukh saisaare ||8||
15.e: Without the perfect Guru there is nothing in this world except suffering.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੯ : ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਝੂਠੇ ਵੈਦ
15.t: pauRee 9 : gur poore binaa(n) jhooThe vaidh
15.e: Exceptthe perfect Guru all physicians are fake

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਰੋਗੀ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ।
15.t: satigur vaidh na sevio rogee vaidh na rog miTaavai|
15.e: The true physician in the form of true Guru (God) has never been served; then how could a physician who himself is diseased remove the malady of others?

15.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ।
15.t: kaam krodh vich lobh moh dhubidhaa kar kar dhroh vadhaavai|
15.e: These worldly physicians who themselves are engrossed in the lust, anger, greed, infatuation, deceive people and enhance their diseases.

15.g: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ।
15.t: aadh biaadh upaadh vich mar mar ja(n)mai dhukh vihaavai|
15.e: This way man involved in these ailments goes on transmigrating and remains full of suffering.

15.g: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ।
15.t: aavai jai bhavaieeaai bhavajal a(n)dhar paar na paavai|
15.e: He goes stray by coming and going and becomes unable to go across the world-ocean.

15.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ।
15.t: aasaa manasaa mohanee taamas tisanaa saa(n)t na aavai|
15.e: Hopes and desires always attract his mind and being guided by evil propensities he never attains peace.

15.g: ਬਲਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੇਲੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅਗਿ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ।
15.t: baladhee a(n)dhar tel pai kiau man moorakh ag bujhaavai|
15.e: How could a manmukh extinguish fire by putting oil on it?

15.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਛੁਡਾਵੈ ॥੯॥
15.t: gur poore vin kaun chhuddaavai ||9||
15.e: Who except the perfect Guru can liberate man from these bondage's?

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੦ : ਝੂਠੇ ਤੀਰਥ
15.t: pauRee 10 : jhooThe teerath
15.e: Fake pilgrimage centres

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਹੀ।
15.t: satigur teerath chhadd kai aThisaTh teerath naavan jaahee|
15.e: Leaving aside pilgrimage centre in the form of the true Guru (God) people go to take bath at the sixty-eight holy places.

15.g: ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਜੰਤਾਂ ਘੁਟਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਖਾਹੀ।
15.t: bagul samaadh lagai kai jiau jal ja(n)taa(n) ghuT ghuT khaahee|
15.e: Like crane, they keep their eyes closed in trance but they catch hold of small creatures, press them hard and eat them.

15.g: ਹਸਤੀ ਨੀਰਿ ਨਵਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਖੇਹ ਉਡਾਹੀ।
15.t: hasatee neer navaaleean baahar nikal kheh uddaahee|
15.e: Elephant is given bath in water, but coming out of water it again spreads dust on its body.

15.g: ਨਦੀ ਨ ਡੁਬੈ ਤੂੰਬੜੀ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ।
15.t: nadhee na ddubai too(n)baRee teerath vis nivaarai naahee|
15.e: Colocynth does not drown in water and even baths at many pilgrimage centres do not let its poison go.

15.g: ਪਥਰੁ ਨੀਰ ਪਖਾਲੀਐ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਨ ਭਿਜੈ ਗਾਹੀ।
15.t: pathar neer pakhaaleeaai chit kaThor na bhijai gaahee|
15.e: Stone put and washed in water remains hard as before and water does not get inside it.

15.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੰਭਲਭੂਸੇ ਖਾਇ ਭਵਾਹੀ।
15.t: manmukh bharam na utarai bha(n)bhalabhoose khai bhavaahee|
15.e: The illusions and doubts of the mind orientated, manmukh, never come to an end and he always wanders in dubiety.

15.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਹੀ ॥੧੦॥
15.t: gur poore vin paar na paahee ||10||
15.e: Without the perfect Guru none can go across the world-ocean.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧ : ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਰਸ
15.t: pauRee 11 : satiguroo paaras
15.e: True Guru is philosopher's stone

15.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਪਥਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਢੂੰਢਣ ਜਾਏ।
15.t: satigur paaras paraharai pathar paaras ddoo(n)ddan jaae|
15.e: Leaving aside the philosophers stone in the form of the true Guru, people go on searching the material philosopher's stone.

15.g: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੁਕਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਏ।
15.t: asaT dhaat ik dhaat kar lukadhaa firai na pragaTee aae|
15.e: The true Guru who can transform eight metals into gold in fact keeps himself hidden and does not get noticed.

15.g: ਲੈ ਵਣਵਾਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ।
15.t: lai vanavaas udhaas hoi maiaadhaaree bharam bhulaae|
15.e: Mammon-orientated person searches him in forests and gets disappointed in many illusions.

15.g: ਹਥੀ ਕਾਲਖ ਛੁਥਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਾਏ।
15.t: hathee kaalakh chhuthiaa a(n)dhar kaalakh lobh lubhaae|
15.e: The touch of riches blackens one's outside and the mind is also smeared by it.

15.g: ਰਾਜ ਡੰਡੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਭੀ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹਾਏ।
15.t: raaj dda(n)dd tis pakaRiaa jam pur bhee jam dda(n)dd sahaae|
15.e: Catching hold of wealth makes one liable to public punishment here and to punishment by the lord of death there in his abode.

15.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੁਦਾਇ ਹਰਾਏ।
15.t: manmukh janam akaarathaa dhoojai bhai kudhai haraae|
15.e: Futile is the birth of mind orientated; he getting engrossed in duality plays the wrong dice and loses the game of life.

15.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧੧॥
15.t: gur poore vin bharam na jaae ||11||
15.e: Illusion cannot be removed without the perfect Guru.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨ : ਗੁਰੂ ਕਲਪ ਬ੍ਰਿੱਛ
15.t: pauRee 12 : guroo kalap bira'chh
15.e: Guru, the wish fulfilling tree

15.g: ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਗਨਿ ਕਲਪ ਤਰੋਂ ਫਲ ਕਚੇ।
15.t: paarijaat gur chhadd kai ma(n)gan kalap taro(n) fal kache|
15.e: Leaving the wish-fulfilling tree in the form of Guru, people desire to have the raw fruits of traditional wish-fulfilling tree (kalptaru/parijat).

15.g: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਲਖ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਸਣੁ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਭਵਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਚੇ।
15.t: paarajaat lakh surag san aavaa gavan bhavan vich pache|
15.e: Millions of parijat along with heavens are getting perished in the cycle of transmigration.

15.g: ਮਰਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਦਿਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਵਿਰਚੇ।
15.t: maradhe kar kar kaamanaa dhit bhugat vich rach virache|
15.e: Controlled by desires people are perishing and are busy in enjoying whatever has been bestowed by the Lord.

15.g: ਤਾਰੇ ਹੋਇ ਅਗਾਸ ਚੜਿ ਓੜਕਿ ਤੁਟਿ ਤੁਟਿ ਥਾਨ ਹਲਚੇ।
15.t: taare hoi agaas chaR oRak tuT tuT thaan halache|
15.e: Man of good actions establish in the sky in the form of stars and after exhausting the results of virtues again become falling stars.

15.g: ਮਾਂ ਪਿਉ ਹੋਏ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਬਚੇ।
15.t: maa(n) piau hoe ketaRe ketaRiaa(n) dhe hoe bache|
15.e: Again through transmigration they become mothers and fathers and many beget children.

15.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜਦੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਹਮਚੇ।
15.t: paap pu(n)n beeau beejadhe dhukh sukh fal a(n)dhar chahamache|
15.e: Further sowing evils and virtues remain immersed in pleasures and sufferings.

15.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਪਰਚੇ ॥੧੨॥
15.t: gur poore vin har na parache ||12||
15.e: Without the perfect Guru, God cannot be made happy.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਮੰਦੇ ਹਾਲ
15.t: pauRee 13 : poore satiguroo binaa(n) ma(n)dhe haal
15.e: Without true Guru hard times are there

15.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੰਭਲਭੂਸੇ।
15.t: sukh saagar guroo chhadd kai bhavajal a(n)dhar bha(n)bhalabhoose|
15.e: Leaving the Guru, the Pleasure Ocean, one tosses up and down in the world-ocean of delusions and deceptions.

15.g: ਲਹਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜੀਅਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਨੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲੂਸੇ।
15.t: laharee naal pachhaaReean haumai aganee a(n)dhar loose|
15.e: The stroke of the waves of the world-ocean tosses and the fire of ego continuously burns the inner self.

15.g: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਜਮਦੂਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਧਕੇ ਧੂਸੇ।
15.t: jam dhar badhe maareean jamadhootaa(n) dhe dhake dhoose|
15.e: Tied and beaten at the door of death, one receives the kicks of the messengers of death.

15.g: ਗੋਇਲਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਨਿ ਈਸੇ ਮੂਸੇ।
15.t: goil vaasaa chaar dhin naau dharain ieese moose|
15.e: May be some one has named himself after Christ or Moses, but in this world all are to stay for a few days.

15.g: ਘਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਅਖਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੋ ਧਾਪੀ ਹੈਰਤ ਹੂਸੇ।
15.t: ghaT na koi akhaidhaa aapo dhaapee hairat hoose|
15.e: Here none deems himself lesser one and all are engrossed in the rat race for selfish ends to find themselves shocked ultimately.

15.g: ਸਾਇਰ ਦੇ ਮਰਜੀਵੜੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਖੇਚਲ ਖੂਸੇ।
15.t: sair dhe marajeevaRe karan majooree khechal khoose|
15.e: Those who are divers of the pleasure-ocean existing in the form of Guru, only they remain happy in the labour (of spiritual discipline).

15.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਡਾਂਗ ਡੰਗੂਸੇ ॥੧੩॥
15.t: gur poore vin ddaa(n)g dda(n)goose ||13||
15.e: Without the true Guru, all are always at loggerheads.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪ : ਭੋਗਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਅੱਗ ਵਧਦੀ ਹੈ
15.t: pauRee 14 : bhogaa(n) naal a'g vadhadhee hai
15.e: Enjoyments increase fire of lust

15.g: ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨ ਗਵਾਏ।
15.t: chi(n)taaman gur chhadd kai chi(n)taaman chi(n)taa na gavaae|
15.e: The traditional wish fulfilling fabulous gem (chintamani) cannot remove anxiety if one could not cultivate the Guru, chintamani.

15.g: ਚਿਤਵਣੀਆ ਲਖ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ।
15.t: chitavaneeaa lakh raat dhih traas na tirasanaa agan bujhaae|
15.e: Many hopes and disappointments scare man day in and day out and the fire of desires it never quenched.

15.g: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਅੰਗਿ ਹੰਢਾਏ।
15.t: suinaa rupaa agalaa maanak motee a(n)g ha(n)ddaae|
15.e: Plenty of gold, wealth, rubies and pearls are worn by man.

15.g: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਪੈਨ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਕਾਏ।
15.t: paaT paTa(n)bar painh ke choaa cha(n)dhan meh mahakaae|
15.e: Wearing silken garment scatters around the fragrance of sandal etc.

15.g: ਹਾਥੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰੇ ਮਹਲ ਬਗੀਚੇ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾਏ।
15.t: haathee ghoRe paakhare mahal bageeche sufal falaae|
15.e: Man keeps elephants, horses, palaces, and fruit laden gardens.

15.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਧੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ।
15.t: su(n)dhar naaree sej sukh maiaa moh dhoh lapaTaae|
15.e: Enjoying the pleasure-giving bed along with beautiful women, he remains engrossed in many deceptions and infatuations.

15.g: ਬਲਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੇਲੁ ਜਿਉ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਏ।
15.t: baladhee a(n)dhar tel jiau aasaa manasaa dhukh vihaae|
15.e: They all are fuels to the fire and man spends life in the sufferings of hopes and desires

15.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੧੪॥
15.t: gur poore vin jam pur jaae ||14||
15.e: He has to reach the abode of Yama (death god) if he remains without the perfect Guru.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫ : ਕੁਦਰਤ ਦਾ ਵਰਣਨ
15.t: pauRee 15 : kudharat dhaa varanan
15.e: Describing the creation

15.g: ਲਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਲਖ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਪਾਰਸ ਲਖ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ।
15.t: lakh teerath lakh dhevate paaras lakh rasain jaanai|
15.e: Millions are pilgrimage centres and so are the gods, the philosopher's stones and chemicals.

15.g: ਲਖ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਆਣੈ।
15.t: lakh chi(n)taaman paarajaat kaamadhen lakh a(n)mirat aanai|
15.e: Millions are chintamanis, wish fulfilling trees and cows, and nectars are also there numbering millions.

15.g: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਣੁ ਸਾਇਰ ਘਣੇ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਣੈ।
15.t: ratanaa san sair ghane ridh sidh nidh sobhaa sulataanai|
15.e: Oceans with pearls, miraculous powers and the adorable kinds are also many.

15.g: ਲਖ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਖ ਫਲ ਲਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੈ।
15.t: lakh padhaarath lakh fal lakh nidhaan a(n)dhar furamaanai|
15.e: Materials, fruits and stores to be present to order are also millions in number.

15.g: ਲਖ ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਨਾਥ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਸੁਹਾਣੈ।
15.t: lakh saeh paatisaeh lakh lakh naath avataar suhaanai|
15.e: Bankers, emperors, naths and grand incarnations are also myriads in number.

15.g: ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਦਾਤੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
15.t: dhaanai keemat naa pavai dhaatai kaun sumaar vakhaanai|
15.e: When charities bestowed cannot be evaluated, how can one describe the extent of the bestower.

15.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥੧੫॥
15.t: kudharat kaadhar no kurabaanai ||15||
15.e: This whole creation is sacrifice unto that creator Lord.

15.g: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬ : ਗੁਰੂ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ
15.t: pauRee 16 : guroo chelaa chelaa guroo
15.e: Guru-Disiple and disciple-Guru ,

15.g: ਰਤਨਾ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ।
15.t: ratanaa dhekhai sabh ko ratan paarakhoo viralaa koiee|
15.e: The jewels are beholden by all but the jeweller is any rare one who test checks the jewels.

15.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਝੈ ਵਿਰਲੋਈ।
15.t: raag naadh sabh ko sunai sabadh surat samajhai viraloiee|
15.e: All listen to the melody and rhythm but a rare one understands the mystery of Word consciousness,

15.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਲ ਪਰੋਈ।
15.t: gursikh ratan padhaarathaa saadhasa(n)gat mil maal paroiee|
15.e: The Sikhs of the Guru are pearls who are strung in the garland in the form of congregation.

15.g: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਰਚਾ ਹੋਈ।
15.t: heerai heeraa bedhiaa sabadh surat mil parachaa hoiee|
15.e: Only his consciousness remains merged in the Word whose mind diamond remains cut by the diamond of Word, the Guru.

15.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ।
15.t: paarabraham pooran braham gur govi(n)dh sin(j)aanai soiee|
15.e: The fact that the transcendental Brahm is the prefect Brahm and the Guru is God, is only identified by a gurmukh, the Guru-orientated one.

15.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਜਾਣੁ ਜਣੋਈ।
15.t: gurmukh sukh fal sahaj ghar piram piaalaa jaan janoiee|
15.e: Only gurmukhs enter the abode of inner knowledge to attain fruits of delight and only they know the delight of the cup of love and make others also know it.

15.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੬॥
15.t: gur chelaa chelaa gur hoiee ||16||
15.e: Then the Guru and the disciple become identical.

15.g: ਪੳੜੀ ੧੭ : ਅੰਗਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਫਲਤਾ
15.t: puRee 17 : a(n)gaa(n) dhee safalataa
15.e: Utility of the organs

15.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਇ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ।
15.t: maanas janam amol hai hoi amol saadhasa(n)g paae|
15.e: Human life is invaluable and by being born man gets the company of the holy congregation.

15.g: ਅਖੀ ਦੁਇ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ।
