18.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ।
18.t: vedh katebahu baaharaa akath kahaanee kathee na jaiee|
18.e: He is beyond all the statements of the Vedas and the Katebas. His ineffable story is beyond all descriptions.

18.g: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਵ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
18.t: abigat gat kiv alakh lakhaiee ||2||
18.e: How could His unmanifest dynamism by seen and understood?

18.g: ੩ : ਕੁਦਰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਾਰੀਗਰੀ ਹੈ
18.t: 3 : kudharat vi'ch kaareegaree hai
18.e: Craftsmanship is there in the creation

18.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਨਕੁ ਕੰਨ ਸਵਾਰੇ।
18.t: jeeau pai tan saajiaa muh akhee nak ka(n)n savaare|
18.e: Creating the jiva (self) He made his body and gave good shape to his mouth, nose, eyes and ears.

18.g: ਹਥ ਪੈਰ ਦੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ।
18.t: hath pair dhe dhaat kar sabadh surat subh dhisaT dhuaare|
18.e: Gracefully He bestowed hands and feet, ears and consciousness for listening to the Word and eye for beholding goodness.

18.g: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸੰਜਾਰੇ।
18.t: kirat virat parakirat bahu saas giraas nivaas sa(n)jaare|
18.e: For earning of the livelihood and other works, he infused life into body.

18.g: ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਪਰਸਦੇ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ।
18.t: raag ra(n)g ras parasadhe ga(n)dh suga(n)dh sa(n)dh parakaare|
18.e: He bestowed various techniques of assimilation of music, colours, smells and fragrances.

18.g: ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲੁ ਟੇਕ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ।
18.t: chhaadhan bhojan budh bal Tek bibek veechaar veechaare|
18.e: For clothing and eating He gave wisdom, power, devotion, and discriminatory wisdom and thought process.

18.g: ਦਾਨੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ।
18.t: dhaane keemat naa pavai besumaar dhaataar piaare|
18.e: The mysteries of that Bestower cannot be understood; that loving Donor keeps with Him myriad's of virtues.

18.g: ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
18.t: lekh alekh asa(n)kh apaare ||3||
18.e: Beyond all accounts, He is infinite and unfathomable.

18.g: ੪ : ਕੁਦਰਤ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚ ਹੈ
18.t: 4 : kudharat lekhe vich hai
18.e: The creation is accountable

18.g: ਪੰਜ ਤਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ।
18.t: pa(n)j tat paravaan kar khaanee chaar jagat upaiaa|
18.e: Mixing the five elements from four (life) mines (egg, foetus, sweat, vegetation) the whole world was created.

18.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚ ਆਵਾਗਵਣ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
18.t: lakh chauraasee joon vich aavaagavan chalat varataiaa|
18.e: Creating the eighty-four lakhs speicies of life, the feat of transmigration has been accomplished in them.

18.g: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਵਧਾਇਆ।
18.t: eikas ikas joon vich jeea ja(n)t anaganat vadhaiaa|
18.e: In each one of the species many a creature has been produced.

18.g: ਲੇਖੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ।
18.t: lekhai a(n)dhar sabh ko sabhanaa masatak lekh likhaiaa|
18.e: All are responsible (for their actions) and carry writ of fate on their forehead.

18.g: ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਦੇ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
18.t: lekhai saas giraas dhe lekh likhaaree a(n)t na paiaa|
18.e: Every breath and morsel is counted. Mystery of writs and that Writer could not be known by any one.

18.g: ਆਪ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
18.t: aap alekh na alakh lakhaiaa ||4||
18.e: Himself imperceptible, He is beyond all writs.

18.g: ੫ : ਕੁਦਰਤ ਭੈ ਵਿਚ ਹੈ
18.t: 5 : kudharat bhai vich hai
18.e: Creation is in fear

18.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਆਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਭੈ ਭਾਰ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
18.t: bhai vich dharat aagaas hai niraadhaar bhai bhaar dharaiaa|
18.e: Earth and sky are in fear but not held by any support, and, that Lord sustains them under the weight of fears.

18.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
18.t: paun paanee baisa(n)taro bhai vich rakhai mel milaiaa|
18.e: Keeping air, water and fire in fear (discipline). He has mixed them all (and has created the world).

18.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਧਰਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਥੰਮ੍ਹਾ ਆਗਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
18.t: paanee a(n)dhar dharat dhar vin tha(n)mhaa aagaas rahaiaa|
18.e: Setting earth in water He has established sky without the support of any props.

18.g: ਕਾਠੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਧਰਿ ਕਰ ਪਰਫੁਲਤੁ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾਇਆ।
18.t: kaaThai a(n)dhar agan dhar kar parafulat sufal falaiaa|
18.e: He kept fire in wood and loading the trees with flowers and fruits made them meaningful.

18.g: ਨਵੀ ਦੁਆਰੀ ਪਵਣੁ ਧਰਿ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
18.t: navee dhuaaree pavan dhar bhai vich sooraj cha(n)dh chalaiaa|
18.e: Keeping air (life) in all the nine doors He made the sun and the moon to move in fear (discipline).

18.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
18.t: nirabhau aap nira(n)jan raiaa ||5||
18.e: That spotless Lord Himself is beyond all fears.

18.g: ੬ : ਕਾਦਰ ਬੇਓੜਕ ਪਰ ਵੵਾਪਕ ਹੈ
18.t: 6 : kaadhar beoRak par vayeaapak hai
18.e: Creator is infinite and omnipresent

18.g: ਲਖ ਅਸਮਾਣ ਉਚਾਣਿ ਚੜਿ ਉਚਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਅੰਬੜਿ ਸਕੈ।
18.t: lakh asamaan uchaan chaR uchaa hoi na a(n)baR sakai|
18.e: Even mounting the lakhs of sky none can reach that highest Lord.

18.g: ਉਚੀ ਹੂ ਊਚਾ ਘਣਾ ਥਾਉ ਗਿਰਾਉ ਨ ਨਾਉ ਅਥਕੈ।
18.t: auchee hoo uoochaa ghanaa thaau giraau na naau athakai|
18.e: He is higher than the highest; He has no (particular) place, residence, name and any fatigue.

18.g: ਲਖ ਪਤਾਲ ਨੀਵਾਣਿ ਜਾਇ ਨੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਨੀਵੈ ਤਕੈ।
18.t: lakh pataal neevaan jai neevaa hoi na neevai takai|
18.e: If someone goes low equal to millions of netherworlds even then he cannot behold Him.

18.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਪਛਮਿ ਉਤਰਾਧਿ ਦਖਣਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਚਉਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਢਕੈ।
18.t: poorab pachham utaraadh dhakhan fer chaufer na ddakai|
18.e: Even the covers of all the four directions - north, east, south, west, cannot over Him.

18.g: ਓੜਕ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਅਖਿ ਫਰਕੈ।
18.t: oRak mool na labhiee utapat paralau akh farakai|
18.e: His expanse cannot be attained; He by one wink of His eye can create and dissolute (the whole cosmos).

18.g: ਫੁਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸ ਮਹਕੈ ॥੬॥
18.t: fulaa a(n)dhar vaas mahakai ||6||
18.e: As the fragrance adorns the flower, the Lord also is present everywhere.

18.g: ੭ : ਕੁਦਰਤ ਦਾ ਭੇਤ ਕਾਦਰ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ
18.t: 7 : kudharat dhaa bhet kaadhar jaanadhaa hai
18.e: Only Creator knows the mystery of creation

18.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਥਿਤਿ ਨ ਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਹੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
18.t: oa(n)kaar akaar kar thit na vaar na maahu janaiaa|
18.e: About the day and month of the creation, the Creator has told nothing to anybody.

18.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
18.t: nira(n)kaar aakaar vin eka(n)kaar na alakh lakhaiaa|
18.e: The Formless One who resided in His own self did not make anybody see His imperceptible form.

18.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉਂ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
18.t: aape aap upai kai aape aapanaa naau(n) dharaiaa|
18.e: Himself He created all and Himself He (for the weal of creatures) established His name in their hearts.

18.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਹੋਂਦਾ ਆਇਆ।
18.t: aadh purakh aadhes hai hai bhee hosee ho(n)dhaa aaiaa|
18.e: I bow before that primal Lord, who is there in the present, who will remain in the future and who was in the beginning as well.

18.g: ਆਦਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
18.t: aadh na a(n)t bia(n)t hai aap aap na aap ganaiaa|
18.e: He is beyond beginning, beyond end and is infinite; but He never makes Himself noticed.

18.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
18.t: aape aap upai samaiaa ||7||
18.e: He created the world and Himself subsumes it in His self.

18.g: ੮ : ਕਾਦਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਤੋਂ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈ
18.t: 8 : kaadhar keete to(n) aga(n)m hai
18.e: The Creator is inaccessible for the creation

18.g: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
18.t: rom rom vich rakhion kar varabha(n)dd karoR samaiee|
18.e: In His one trichome He has subsumed crores of universes.

18.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਜਾਈ।
18.t: kevadd vaddaa aakheeaai kit ghar vasai kevadd jaiee|
18.e: What can be said about His expanse, His abode and the extent of His place?

18.g: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਅਮਾਉ ਹੈ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ।
18.t: eik kavaau amaau hai lakh dhareeaau na keemat paiee|
18.e: Even His one sentence is beyond all limits and its evaluation cannot be done by millions of rivers of knowledge.

18.g: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ।
18.t: paravadhagaar apaar hai paaraavaar na alakh lakhaiee|
18.e: That sustainer of the world is inaccessible; his beginning and end is imperceptible.

18.g: ਏਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਈ।
18.t: evadd vaddaa hoi kai kithai rahiaa aap lukaiee|
18.e: Being so much great where has He hidden Himself?

18.g: ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
18.t: sur nar naath rahe liv laiee ||8||
18.e: To know this, the gods, men and many a nath are ever in concentration upon Him.

18.g: ੯ : ਕਾਦਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਤੋਂ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈ
18.t: 9 : kaadhar keete to(n) aga(n)m hai
18.e: The Creator is inaccessible for the creation

18.g: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਕਵਾਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਅਥਾਹ ਵਹੰਦੇ।
18.t: lakh dhareeaau kavaau vich at asagaeh athaeh vaha(n)dhe|
18.e: In His will lakhs of deep and unfathomable rivers (of life) go on flowing.

18.g: ਆਦਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਫੇਰ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ।
18.t: aadh na a(n)t bia(n)t hai agam agochar fer fira(n)dhe|
18.e: Beginning and end of those life currents cannot be understood.

18.g: ਅਲਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਲਹੰਦੇ।
18.t: alakh apaar vakhaaneeaai paaraavaar na paar laha(n)dhe|
18.e: They are infinite, inaccessible and imperceptible but still all move in the Lord, the great. They cannot know the extent of that imperceptible and boundless Lord.

18.g: ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਲਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਗਮ ਰੰਗ ਰਵੰਦੇ।
18.t: lahar tara(n)g nisa(n)g lakh saagar sa(n)gam ra(n)g rava(n)dhe|
18.e: Rivers having myriad's of waves meeting the ocean becomes one with it.

18.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਤੁਲੰਦੇ।
18.t: ratan padhaarath lakh lakh mul amul na tul tula(n)dhe|
18.e: In that ocean are lakhs of invaluable jewel materials, which in fact are beyond all costing.

18.g: ਸਦਕੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ਸਿਰੰਦੇ ॥੯॥
18.t: sadhake sirajanahaar sira(n)dhe ||9||
18.e: I am sacrifice unto that Creator Lord.

18.g: ੧੦ : ਕਾਦਰ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਤੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੈ
18.t: 10 : kaadhar niralep te pooran hai
18.e: The Creator is detached and perfect

18.g: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ।
18.t: paravadhagaar salaaheeaai siraTh upaiee ra(n)g bira(n)gee|
18.e: That sustainer Lord ought to be praised who has created the multicoloured creation.

18.g: ਰਾਜਿਕੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਹਿਦਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਣਮੰਗੀ।
18.t: raajik rijak sabaahidhaa sabhanaa dhaat kare anama(n)gee|
18.e: He is bestower of livelihood to everyone and giver of charity unasked for.

18.g: ਕਿਸੈ ਜਿਵੇਹਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੰਦੀ ਚੰਗੀ।
18.t: kisai jivehaa naeh ko dhubidhaa a(n)dhar ma(n)dhee cha(n)gee|
18.e: None resembles anyone and the jiva (creative) is good or bad according to the ratio of perplexity in him.

18.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਲੰਗੀ।
18.t: paarabraham niralep hai pooran braham sadhaa sahala(n)gee|
18.e: Being transcendent, He is detached from every thing and being perfect Brahm. He is always with everybody.

18.g: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਰਬੰਗੀ।
18.t: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa sabhanaa a(n)dhar hai saraba(n)gee|
18.e: He is beyond caste and symbols etc. but side by side He pervades one and all.

18.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੧੦॥
18.t: paun paanee baisa(n)tar sa(n)gee ||10||
18.e: He is in air, water and fire i.e. He is the power of these elements.

18.g: ੧੧ : ਮਾਯਕ ਉਤਪਤੀ ਕਾਰਣ
18.t: 11 : maayak utapatee kaaran
18.e: Reasons for the creation of maya

18.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਖੀ ਇਕ ਉਪਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ।
18.t: oa(n)kaar aakaar kar makhee ik upaiee maiaa|
18.e: The Oankar creating the forms created a fly named maya.

18.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਣੁ ਜਲ ਥਲੁ ਮਹੀਅਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਛਾਇਆ।
18.t: tin loa chaudheh bhavan jal thal maheeal chhal kar chhaiaa|
18.e: It cheated profusely all the three worlds, fourteen abodes, water, surface and the nether world.

18.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹੇਸ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਜਾਰਿ ਨਚਾਇਆ।
18.t: brahamaa bisan mahes trai dhas avataar bajaar nachaiaa|
18.e: All the ten incarnations, besides Brahma, Visnu, Mahesa, it made to dance in the bazar in the form of world.

18.g: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਬਹੁ ਪੰਥ ਭਵਾਇਆ।
18.t: jatee satee sa(n)tokheeaa sidh naath bahu pa(n)th bhavaiaa|
18.e: The celibates, the chaste ones, the contented people, siddhas and naths all were made to move astray on the paths of various sects.

18.g: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਲੜਾਇਆ।
18.t: kaam karodh virodh vich lobh moh kar dhroh laRaiaa|
18.e: Maya infused lust, anger, opposition, greed, infatuation, and deceit in all and made them to have infightings.

18.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭਕੋ ਸੇਰਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਕਿਨੈ ਅਖਾਇਆ।
18.t: haumai a(n)dhar sabhako serahu ghaT na kinai akhaiaa|
18.e: Full of ego they are hollow from inside but none accepts himself imperfect (all feel they are the full measure and nothing less than it).

18.g: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
18.t: kaaran karate aap lukaiaa ||11||
18.e: The Creator Lord Himself has concealed the reason for all this.

18.g: ੧੨ : ਹੁਕਮ
18.t: 12 : hukam
18.e: Majestic orders of the emperors

18.g: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਬਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਵਡੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ।
18.t: paatisaahaa(n) paatisaahu hai abachal raaj vaddee paatisaahee|
18.e: He (the Lord) is emperor of emperors whose rule is stable and kingdom greatly large.

18.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਦਰਗਾਹੀ।
18.t: kevadd takhat vakhaaneeaai kevadd mahal kevadd dharagaahee|
18.e: How big are His throne, palace and the court.

18.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਲਖੁ ਅਵਗਾਹੀ।
18.t: kevadd sifat salaaheeaai kevadd maal mulakh avagaahee|
18.e: How should He be eulogised and how could be known the expanse of His treasure and territory?

18.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਲਸਕਰ ਸੇਵ ਸਿਪਾਹੀ।
18.t: kevadd maan mahat hai kevadd lasakar sev sipaahee|
18.e: How great is His grandeur and magnificence and how many soldiers and armies are there in His service?

18.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੀ।
18.t: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko kevadd hukam na beparavaahee|
18.e: Everything is under His order is so much organised and powerful that no carelessness is there.

18.g: ਹੋਰਸੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਮਤਾ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ॥੧੨॥
18.t: horas puchh na mataa nibaahee ||12||
18.e: He asks none to arrange all this.

18.g: ੧੩ : ਕੀਤੇ ਨੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ
18.t: 13 : keete ne karataa visaariaa
18.e: The creation forgot the creator

18.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੜੑਹਿ ਇਕਸ ਅਖਰ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ।
18.t: lakh lakh brahame vedh paR(h)h ikas akhar bhedh na jaataa|
18.e: Even after reading lakhs of Vedas, Brahma did not understand syllable (paramatama)

18.g: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਹੇਸ ਲਖ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਭੇਖੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ।
18.t: jog dhiaan mahes lakh roop na rekh na bhekh pachhaataa|
18.e: Siva meditates through lakhs of methods (postures) but still could not recognise the form, hue and guise (of the Lord).

18.g: ਲਖ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਨ ਪਛਾਤਾ।
18.t: lakh avataar akaar kar til veechaar na bisan pachhaataa|
18.e: Visnu incarnated himself through lakhs of creatures but he could not recognise even a bit of that Lord.

18.g: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਨਉਤਨ ਨਾਉ ਲੈ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸੇਖ ਵਿਸੇਖ ਨ ਤਾਤਾ।
18.t: lakh lakh nautan naau lai lakh lakh sekh visekh na taataa|
18.e: Sesanag (the mythical snake) recited and remembered many a new name of the Lord but still could not know much about Him.

18.g: ਚਿਰ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਹੰਢਣੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਪੰਥ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਤਾ।
18.t: chir jeevan bahu ha(n)ddane dharasan pa(n)th na sabadh sin(j)aataa|
18.e: Many long-lived persons experienced life variously, but they all and many a philosopher could not understand Sabda, the Brahma.

18.g: ਦਾਤਿ ਲੁਭਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਨਿ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੧੩॥
18.t: dhaat lubhai visaaran dhaataa ||13||
18.e: All got engrossed in the gifts of that Lord and that bestower has been forgotten.

18.g: ੧੪ : ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਕੂੰ ਪਾਵੇ ? ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹ
18.t: 14 : keetaa karate noo(n) kikoo(n) paave ? gaaddee raah
18.e: How creation could attain the Creator? The highway     ?

18.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
18.t: nira(n)kaar aakaar kar gur moorat hui dhiaan dharaiaa|
18.e: The formless Lord assumed shape and getting established in the form of Guru made all to meditate upon Lord (here the hint is towards Guru Nanak).

18.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
18.t: chaar varan gursikh kar saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd vasaiaa|
18.e: He accepted disciples from all the four varnas and founded the abode of treuth in the form of holy congregation.

18.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
18.t: vedh katebahu baaharaa akath kathaa gur sabadh sunaiaa|
18.e: He explained the grandeur of that word of the Guru beyond the Vedas and the Katebas.

18.g: ਵੀਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਮਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਹ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
18.t: veehaa a(n)dhar varatamaan gurmukh hoi ikeeh lakhaiaa|
18.e: Those who indulged in scores of evils were now put to meditate upon the Lord.

18.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
18.t: maiaa vich udhaas kar naam dhaan isanaan dhiRaiaa|
18.e: They were kept detached amidst maya and were made to understand the importance of that holy name, charity and ablution.

18.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
18.t: baareh pa(n)th ikatr kar gurmukh gaaddee raahu chalaiaa|
18.e: Gathering the twelve sects together, he prepared a high path of gurmukhs.

18.g: ਪਤਿ ਪਉੜੀ ਚੜਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
18.t: pat pauRee chaR nij ghar aaiaa ||14||
18.e: Following that path (or order) and mounting the stairs of honour they have all stabilised in their true selves.

18.g: ੧੫ : ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹ ਦੇ ਰਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ
18.t: 15 : gaaddee raeh dhe raahee gurmukh
18.e: Gurmukhs the treaders of the highway

18.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੈਰ ਧਰਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਾਟ ਕੁਵਾਟ ਨ ਧਾਇਆ।
18.t: gurmukh maarag pair dhar dhubidhaa vaaT kuvaaT na dhaiaa|
18.e: Following the path of being gurmukh man does not read on the wrong way of uncertainty.

18.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਕੈ ਮਰਦਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ।
18.t: satigur dharasan dhekhikai maradhaa jaa(n)dhaa nadhar na aaiaa|
18.e: After beholding the true Guru, one does not see life, death, coming and going.

18.g: ਕੰਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
18.t: ka(n)nee satigur sabadh sun anahadh run jhunakaar sunaiaa|
18.e: Listening to the world of true Guru he becomes attuned to the unstruck melody.

18.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇ ਕੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
18.t: satigur saranee aai kai nihachal saadhoo sa(n)g milaiaa|
18.e: Coming to the shelter of the true Guru now man absorbs in the stabilising holy congregation.

18.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸਿ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
18.t: charan kaval makara(n)dh ras sukh sa(n)paT vich sahaj samaiaa|
18.e: He subsumes himself in the delight of the lotus feet.

18.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
18.t: piram piaalaa apiau peeaaiaa ||15||
18.e: Gurmukhs remain exhilarated after quaffing the hard to drink the cup of love.

18.g: ੧੬ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਣ ਮੁਕਤ ਪਦ
18.t: 16 : gurmukh dhaa jeevan mukat padh
18.e: Gurmukh,the liberated one in life

18.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣਾ।
18.t: saadhasa(n)gat kar saadhanaa piram piaalaa ajar jaranaa|
18.e: Adopting the discipline in the holy congregation, the unbearable cup of love is drunk and endured.

18.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਮਰਣਾ।
18.t: pairee pai paakhaak hoi aap gavai jeeva(n)dhiaa maranaa|
18.e: Then the individual falling at the feet and eschewing ego dies in relation to all the worldly concerns.

18.g: ਜੀਵਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਡੁਬਿ ਡੁਬਿ ਤਰਣਾ।
18.t: jeevan mukat vakhaaneeaai mar mar jeevan ddub ddub taranaa|
18.e: Liberated in life is he who dies of maya and lives up in the love of God.

18.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਤੈ ਅਉਚਰ ਚਰਣਾ।
18.t: sabadh surat livaleen hoi apio peean tai aauchar charanaa|
18.e: Merging his consciousness in Word and quaffing the nectar he eats up his ego.

18.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਅਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰਣਾ।
18.t: anahadh naadh aves kar a(n)mirat vaanee nijhar jharanaa|
18.e: Inspired by the unstruck melody he always goes on pouring the word-nectar.

18.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਹੋਇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣ ਨ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣਾ।
18.t: karan kaaran samarath hoi kaaran karan na kaaran karanaa|
18.e: Now he is already cause of all the causes but still does nothing harmful to others.

18.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਅਸਰਣ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧੬॥
18.t: patit udhaaran asaran saranaa ||16||
18.e: Such a person salvages the sinners and provides shelter to the shelterless.

18.g: ੧੭ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਦਾ ਤਰਨਾ ਤਾਰਨਾ
18.t: 17 : gurmukh dhaa taranaa taaranaa
18.e: Remaining detached and suffering a lot the gurmukh does good to others

18.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਣਾ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹਿਣਾ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਲਣਾ।
18.t: gurmukh bhai vich ja(n)manaa bhai vich rahinaa bhai vich chalanaa|
18.e: The gurmukhs take birth in the divine will, they remain in the divine will and move in the divine will.

18.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਣਾ।
18.t: saadhasa(n)gat bhai bhai vich bhagat vachhal kar achhal chhalanaa|
18.e: In the discipline and love of the holy congregation they fascinate the Lord God also.

18.g: ਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਹੋਇ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਵਲੇਵੈ ਵਲਣਾ।
18.t: jal vich kaval alipat hoi aas niraas valevai valanaa|
18.e: Being detached like lotus in the water they remain away from the cycle of hopes and disappointments.

18.g: ਅਹਰਣਿ ਘਣ ਹੀਰੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਨ ਟਲਣਾ।
18.t: aharan ghan heere jugat gurmat nihachal aTal na Talanaa|
18.e: They remain steadfast like a diamond in between the hammer and the anvil and live their life deeply rooted in the wisdom of the Guru (gurmati).

18.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਦੈਆ ਮੋਮ ਵਾਂਗੀ ਢਲਣਾ।
18.t: paraupakaar veechaar vich jeea dhaiaa mom vaa(n)gee ddalanaa|
18.e: They always imbibe altruism in their heart and in the sphere of compassion they melt like wax.

18.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਰਲਣਾ।
18.t: chaar varan ta(n)bol ras aap gavai ralaiaa ralanaa|
18.e: As four items mix up in betel and become one, likewise the gurmukhs get adjusted with every one.

18.g: ਵਟੀ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਲਣਾ ॥੧੭॥
18.t: vaTee tel dheevaa hoi balanaa ||17||
18.e: They, in the form of lamp becoming wick and oil, burn themselves (for lighting others).

18.g: ੧੮ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਦੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ
18.t: 18 : gurmukhaa(n) dhee mukatee dhee jugat
18.e: The pleasure-fruit of the gurmukhs and its grandeur

18.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ।
18.t: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath karoR na oRak jaanai|
18.e: Crores of properties such as truth, contentment, pity, dharma, lucre are there but none could know the extremity of that (pleasure-fruit).

18.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਲਖੂਣਿ ਨ ਪਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
18.t: chaar padhaarath aakheean hoi lakhoon na pal paravaanai|
18.e: Four ideals are said to be and may be they are multiplied by lakhs, even then they do not equal the one moment of pleasure fruit.

18.g: ਰਿਧੀ ਸਿਧੀ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਲਖ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਣੈ।
18.t: ridhee sidhee lakh lakh nidh nidhaan lakh til na tulaanai|
18.e: Riddhis, Siddhis and lakhs of treasures do not equal its one small fraction.

18.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਖ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਖ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
18.t: dharasan dhirasaT sa(n)jog lakh sabadh surat liv lakh hairaanai|
18.e: Seeing the intimacy of Word and the consciousness, many combinations of philosophies and meditations are surprised.

18.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਅਸੰਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਲਖਨੇਤ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
18.t: giaan dhiaan simaran asa(n)kh bhagat jugat lakhanet vakhaanai|
18.e: Many methods of knowledge, meditation and remembrance are put forth;

18.g: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।
18.t: piram piaalaa sahaj ghar gurmukh sukhafal choj viddaanai|
18.e: But reaching the tranquil stage, the pleasure-fruit of the cup of love of the Lord attained by gurmukhs is wondrous.

18.g: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਲਖ ਮੇਲ ਮਿਲਾਣੈ ॥੧੮॥
18.t: mat budh sudh lakh mel milaanai ||18||
18.e: At this stage, intellect, wisdom and millions of purities get combined.

18.g: ੧੯ : ਸੱਚ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਆਚਾਰ ਹੈ
18.t: 19 : sa'ch sreshaT aachaar hai
18.e: Truthfulness is the best conduct

18.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਕਰੋੜੀ।
18.t: jap tap sa(n)jam lakh lakh hom jag nieevedh karoRee|
18.e: Millions of rituals of recitation, penances, continence, burnt offerings and crores of oblations are there.

18.g: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਘਣੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਲਖ ਤੰਦੁ ਮਰੋੜੀ।
18.t: varat nem sa(n)jam ghane karam dharam lakh ta(n)dh maroRee|
18.e: Fasts, rules, controls, activities are many but they all are like a weak thread.

18.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਖ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨੁ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਨ ਓੜੀ।
18.t: teerath purab sa(n)jog lakh pu(n)n dhaan upakaar na oRee|
18.e: Many are pilgrimage centres, anniversaries, and millions of virtuous acts, charities and altruism's.

18.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਣੇ ਵਰ ਸਰਾਪ ਲਖ ਜੋੜ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ।
18.t: dhevee dhev sarevane var saraap lakh joR vichhoRee|
18.e: Millions kinds of worship of gods and goddesses, combinations, detractions, boons, curses are there.

18.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਲਖ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੀ।
18.t: dharasan varan avaran lakh poojaa arachaa ba(n)dhan toRee|
18.e: Many philosophies, varnas, non-varnas and many are the persons who do not bother about the (unnecessary) brands of lakhs of worships and oblations.

18.g: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਖ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲਖ ਝਾੜਿ ਪਛੋੜੀ।
18.t: lok vedh gun giaan lakh jog bhog lakh jhaaR pachhoRee|
18.e: Many are the means of public behaviour, virtues, renunciation, indulgence and other covering devices;

18.g: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਹੁ ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸੱਭਾ ਥੋੜੀ।
18.t: sachahu orai sabh kih lakh siaanap sa'bhaa thoRee|
18.e: But all these are craftsmanship's remain away from the truth; they cannot touch it.

18.g: ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ਚਮੋੜੀ ॥੧੯॥
18.t: aupar sach achaar chamoRee ||19||
18.e: Higher than truth is truthful living.

18.g: ੨੦ : ਸੱਚਾ ਰਾਜ
18.t: 20 : sa'chaa raaj
18.e: The true kingdom

18.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਤਖਤੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
18.t: satigur sachaa paatisaahu saadhasa(n)gat sach takhat suhelaa|
18.e: The true Guru (God) is the true emperor and the holy congregation is true throne which is most delightful.

18.g: ਸਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਟਕਸਾਲ ਸਚੁ ਅਸਟਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਪਾਰਸ ਮੇਲਾ।
18.t: sach sabadh Takasaal sach asaTadhaat ik paaras melaa|
18.e: The true Word is such a true mint where different castes in the from of metals meet the Guru, the philosopher's stone, and become gold (gurmukhs).

18.g: ਸਚਾ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨਵਹਾਣੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ।
18.t: sachaa abichal raaj hai sach mahal navahaan navelaa|
18.e: There, only the true divine Will operates because the order of truth alone is bestower of joy and delight.

18.g: ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੋ ਰਸ ਕੇਲਾ।
18.t: sachaa hukam varatadhaa sachaa amar sacho ras kelaa|
18.e: There, only the true divine Will operates because the order of truth alone is bestower of joy and delight.

18.g: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ।
18.t: sachee sifat salaeh sach sach salaahan a(n)mirat velaa|
18.e: There, in the early morning eulogisation is true and is of the truth alone.

18.g: ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲਾ।
18.t: sachaa gurmukh pa(n)th hai sach upadhes na garab gahelaa|
18.e: There, in the early morning eulogisation is true and is of the truth alone.

18.g: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਗਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲਾ।
18.t: aasaa vich niraas gat sachaa khel mel sach khelaa|
18.e: Gurmukhs remain detached among many hopes and they always play the game of truth.

18.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ॥੨੦॥
18.t: gurmukh sikh guroo gur chelaa ||20||
18.e: Such gurmukhs become Guru and the Guru becomes their disciple.

18.g: ੨੧ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਅਲੇਪਤਾ
18.t: 21 : gurmukhaa(n) dhee alepataa
18.e: Non attachment of the gurmukhs

18.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਣਾ।
18.t: gurmukh haumai paraharai man bhaavai khasamai dhaa bhaanaa|
18.e: Gurmukh repudiates ego and he likes the will of God.

18.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ।
18.t: pairee pai paakhaak hoi dharageh paavai maan nimaanaa|
18.e: Becoming humble and falling at the feet he becomes dust and earns honour in the court of the Lord.

18.g: ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹੋਵਣਹਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ।
18.t: varatamaan vich varatadhaa hovanahaar soiee paravaanaa|
18.e: He always moves in the present i.e. never ignores the contemporary situations and side by side accepts whatever is likely to happen.

18.g: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਕਰਾਣਾ।
18.t: kaaran karataa jo karai sir dhar ma(n)n karai sukaraanaa|
18.e: Whatever is done by the creator of all the causes, is gratefully accepted by him.

18.g: ਰਾਜੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ।
18.t: raajee hoi rajai vich dhuneeaa(n) a(n)dhar jiau mihamaanaa|
18.e: He remains happy in the will of the Lord and considers himself a guest in the world.

18.g: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ।
18.t: visamaadhee visamaadh vich kudharat kaadhar no kurabaanaa|
18.e: He remains elated in the love of the Lord and goes sacrificed unto the feats of the creator.

18.g: ਲੇਪ ਅਲੇਪ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨੧॥
18.t: lep alep sadhaa nirabaanaa ||21||
18.e: Living in the world he remains detached and liberated.

18.t: 22 : ba(n)dhe vikhe
18.e: The obedient person always in obedience

18.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹਣਾ।
18.t: hukamee ba(n)dhaa hoi kai saahib dhe hukamai vich rahanaa|
18.e: One should remain in the will of the Lord by becoming an obedient servant.

18.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਆਵਟਣ ਹੈ ਸਹਣਾ।
18.t: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko sabhanaa aavaTan hai sahanaa|
18.e: All are in His will and all have to bear the heat of the divine order.

18.g: ਦਿਲੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਵਹਣਾ।
18.t: dhil dhareeaau samaau kar garab gavai gareebee vahanaa|
18.e: Man should make his heart a river and let the water of humility flow into it.

18.g: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣਿ ਬਹਣਾ।
18.t: veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh kai saadhasa(n)gat si(n)ghaasan bahanaa|
18.e: Leaving the worldly activities one should sit on the throne of holy congregation.

18.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਭਉ ਅਘੜ ਘੜਾਏ ਗਹਣਾ।
18.t: sabadh surat livaleen hoi anabhau aghaR ghaRaae gahanaa|
18.e: Merging consciousness in the Word, one should get the ornament of fearlessness prepared.

18.g: ਸਿਦਕ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸਾਬਤਾ ਸਾਕਰੁ ਸੁਕਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਣਾ ਲਹਣਾ।
18.t: sidhak sabooree saabataa saakar sukar na dhenaa lahanaa|
18.e: One should remain true in faith and contentment; the transaction of thankfulness should be kept to continue and one should remain away from worldly give and take.

18.g: ਨੀਰਿ ਨ ਡੁਬਣੁ ਅਗਿ ਨ ਦਹਣਾ ॥੨੨॥
18.t: neer na dduban ag na dhahanaa ||22||
18.e: Such a person neither drowns in water (of maya) nor gets burnt in the fire (of desire).

18.g: ੨੩ : ਗੁਰੂ ਅਤੇ ਸਿੱਖ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ
18.t: 23 : guroo ate si'kh dhee preetee
18.e: Love between the Guru and the disiple

18.g: ਮਿਹਰ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਆਸਕੀ ਇਸਕੁ ਮੁਸਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਲੁਕੈ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ।
18.t: mihar muhabat aasakee isak musak kiau lukai lukaiaa|
18.e: Kindness, affection, passionate love and smell do not remain concealed even if they are hidden and of their own get manifested.

18.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਗੰਧੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
18.t: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat hoi suga(n)dh na aap ganaiaa|
18.e: Sandal makes the whole vegetation fragrant and never makes it self noticed (but still people come to know that).

18.g: ਨਦੀਆ ਨਾਲੇ ਗੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
18.t: nadheeaa naale ga(n)g mil hoi pavit na aakh sunaiaa|
18.e: Rivers and streams meet the Ganges and silently become pure without any announcement.

18.g: ਹੀਰੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਅਣੀ ਕਣੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
18.t: heere heeraa bedhiaa anee kanee hoi ridhai samaiaa|
18.e: The diamond is cut by the diamond and the cutter diamond looks as if it has adopted the other diamond in its heart (likewise the Guru also cutting the mind of disciple gives place to him in his own heart).

18.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਹੋਇ ਪਾਰਸ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ।
18.t: saadhasa(n)gat mil saadh hoi paaras mil paaras hoi aaiaa|
18.e: The disciple of the Guru becomes such a sadhu in the holy congregation as if someone becomes philosopher's stone after touching the philosopher's stone.

18.g: ਨਿਹਚਉ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਾਇਆ।
18.t: nihachau nihachal gurmatee bhagat vachhal hoi achhal chhalaiaa|
18.e: With the steadfast teaching of the Guru, the mind of the Sikh becomes peaceful and God also becoming affectionate towards the devotee gets deluded.

18.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੨੩॥੧੮॥
18.t: gurmukh sukh fal alakh lakhaiaa ||23||18||
18.e: Getting a sight of the imperceptible Lord is the pleasure-fruit for the gurmukhs.

19.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
Ekankar, the Lors second to none, created gurmukh (to liberate the world).
That Oankar assuming forms has become manifest.
By extension (and combination) of the five elements this world has been created.
The four mines of life and four speeches ( para, pasyanti, madhyama, vaikhari) have been generated.

19.g: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
19.t: kudharat agam apaar a(n)t na paiaa|
19.e: His feats of amusements are inaccessible and limitless; their extremes are unattainable.
The name of that creator is Truth and He is ever immersed in Truth.
The best among the eightyfour lakhs of species of life
Souls wander fruitlessly in the eighty-four lakhs of species of life.
The rare human body has been obtained owing to virtuous actions.
Moving on greatest path of the Guru orientated, the self has lost the ego.
Maintaining the discipline of the holy congregation has come to fall at the feet (of the Guru).
Gurmukhs have adopted the name of the Lord, the charity, the ablution and truthful conduct steadfastly.
The man has merged his consciousness in the Word and has accepted the will of the Lord.
Gurmukh is the guest ,
Gurmukh taught by the Guru is well trained and knowledgeable.
He understands that he has come to the assembly of this world as a guest.
He eats and drinks what is bestowed by the Lord.

19.g: ਕਰੈ ਨ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਣੁ ਹਸੈ ਹਸਾਇਆ।
19.t: karai na garab gumaan hasai hasaiaa|
19.e: Gurmukh is not arrogant and feels happy in the happiness given by the Lord.
Only that guest gets accepted in the court of the Lord who has lived here as a good guest.
He moves from here silently and makes the whole assembly wonders struck (because others feel very difficult to leave this world).
Method of moving around ,
Gurmukh knows this world as a place of rest for a few days.
Here with the help of wealth many types of sports and feats are enacted.
In this very world, for gurmukhs incessant rain of nectar goes on pouring.
On the tune of flute (the unstruck melody) they go on enjoying the delight of the assembly.
Well-trained and knowledgeable persons sing Majh and Malhar musical measures here i.e. they enjoy the present.

19.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਣੀਐ।
19.t: haumai garab nivaar man vas aaneeaai|
19.e: They lose their ego and control their minds.
Contemplating the Word, the Gurmukh identifies the truth.
Moving teachnique - living an inn ,
A wayfarer, on the way halted in an inn.
Then moved forward on the told path.

19.g: ਨਾਹਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਤਾਤਿ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਹਸਿਆ।
19.t: naeh paraiee taat na chit rahasiaa|
19.e: He neither got envious with anyone nor did he get infatuated by any.

19.g: ਮੁਏ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਵਿਵਾਹਿ ਨ ਹਸਿਆ।
19.t: mue na puchhai jaat vivaeh na hasiaa|
19.e: He neither asked the caste (identity) of any dying person nor he felt any delight witnessing the marriage ceremonies etc.

19.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਜੁ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਸਿਆ।
19.t: dhaataa karai ju dhaat na bhukhaa tasiaa|
19.e: He happily accepted gifts of the Lord and never remained hungry or thirsty.
The lotus face of the gurmukh always remains in blossom due to continuous remembrance of the Lord.
Moving teachnique - living an inn
Lamps are lighted in the night of divali festival;
Stars of different variety appear in the sky;

19.g: ਫੁਲਾਂ ਦੀ ਬਾਗਾਤਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਚਾਲੀਅਨਿ।
19.t: fulaa(n) dhee baagaat chun chun chaaleean|
19.e: In the gardens the flowers are there which are selectively plucked;
The pilgrims going to pilgrimage centres are also seen.
The imaginary habitats have been seen coming into being and vanishing.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੀਅਨਿ ॥੬॥
19.t: gurmukh sukh fal dhaat sabadh samhaaleean ||6||
19.e: All these are momentary, but the gurmukhs with the help of the Word nourish the gift of the pleasure fruit.
Way of the world - parent's home -
The gurmukh who have received well with the Guru's teachings have got their minds enlightened.
They have understood that the world is like a parental home; one has to go one day from here and hence all their doubts have been removed.
They are unattached amid hopes and remain charged with the knowledge.
They spread message of the Word in accordance with the conduct of the holy congregation.
The idea that they are servants of the servants of the Lord has got deeply rooted in the wisdom of the gurmukhs.
Be they anywhere in the country or abroad they remember God with every inhalation and exhalation of breath.
Technique of life - , ,
As in a boat per-chance many persons unknown to each other meet, likewise the creatures in the world meet each other.
The world is such as if ruling a kingdom and enjoying the pleasures in a dream.

19.g: ਕਦੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ਤਰਵਰ ਛਾਇਆ।
19.t: kadhe harakh kadhe sog taravar chhaiaa|
19.e: Here happiness and sufferings are like shade of the tree.

19.g: ਕਟੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
19.t: kaTai haumai rog na aap ganaiaa|
19.e: Here in fact he has decimated the malady of ego who has not made himself to be noticed.

19.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ।
19.t: ghar hee a(n)dhar jog gurmukh paiaa|
19.e: Becoming gurmukh, individual even being at one's home attains union (with the Lord).
The Guru has made him understand that destiny cannot be averted (hence one without being worried should go on doing one's works).
Method in the world - desirelessness -
Gurmukhs have learnt the technique of life in the holy congregation.

19.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ।
19.t: chet basa(n)t sura(n)g sabh ra(n)g maaniaa|
19.e: They have consciously enjoyed the delight of the spring season of life.
They are elated like the water of rainy season (Savan) but still they (gurmukhs) have made water of hopes and desires go down and downward.

19.g: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਲੁ ਸੁ ਢੰਗ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਿਆ।
19.t: sajan melu su dda(n)g choj viddaaniaa|
19.e: Meeting with such persons is wonderfully delightful.
They way of gurmukhs is devoid of mire and is accepted in the court of the Lord.
A meeting through the wisdom of the Guru is obstruction free, true and delightful.
Success of the birth

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ।
19.t: gurmukh safal jana(n)m jag vich aaiaa|
19.e: Blest is the birth of a gurmukh and his coming to this world.
In accordance with the wisdom of the Guru he deletes his ego and accomplishes the (virtuous) actions.

19.g: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਮ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ।
19.t: bhaau bhagat kar ka(n)m sukh fal paiaa|
19.e: He works controlled by his love for work and loving devotion, and receives the pleasure fruit (of life).
The inaccessible teachings of the Guru he adopts in his heart.
Keeping of the flag of forbearance and dharma high, becomes his innate nature.

19.g: ਸਹੈ ਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੰਮੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
19.t: sahai na dhookh saha(n)m bhaanaa bhaiaa ||10||
19.e: He bows before the will of the Lord and never suffers any fear or sorrow.
Gurmukh-mind
Gurmukhs know (very well) that human birth is a rare opportunity.
That is why they cultivate love for holy congregation and enjoy all delights.
They speak after merging their consciousness in the Word.
They become bodiless while living in body and identify the truth.

19.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਓਹੁ ਨ ਏਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਦੇ।
19.t: dhubidhaa oh na eh ik pachhaanadhe|
19.e: They do not have this or that dilemma and know only one Lord.

19.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ਥੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਣਦੇ ॥੧੧॥
19.t: chaar dhihaaRe theh man vich aanadhe ||11||
19.e: They know in their heart of heart that within a short period this world is going to become a mound (of earth) and hence they do not develop any attachment with it.
Reality of gurmukh
Rarely comes a benevolent gurmukh who serves others.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
19.t: gurmukh sukh fal pai aap gavaiaa|
19.e: The Gurmukh abandons ego and receives the fruit of delight.
Only the gurmukh tells the story of the (grandeur of ) Word to the disciples (of the Guru) and never claims to tell something as his own.
Deeply pondering over the Word, a gurmukh practices truth in his life,

19.g: ਸਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ।
19.t: sach ridhai muh sach sach suhaiaa|
19.e: He likes the truth, which resides in his heart as well as speech.
Such a gurmukh not only spruces his own life he rather gets the whole world across.
Conduct of the gurmukh
The Gurmukh losing his ego and identifies his self.
The Gurmukh enters his innate nature through truth and contentment.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਣਿਆ।
19.t: gurmukh dheeraj dharam dhiaa sukh maaniaa|
19.e: The Gurmukh alone enjoys the true delights of forbearance, dharma and compassion.
Gurmukhs very well understand the importance of the words first, and only then they speak them out.
Though being powerful, the gurmukhs always consider themselves weak and humble.
Because the gurmukhs are polite, they receive respects in the court of the Lord.
The Gurmukhs always accept the divine order
Spending this life fruitfully the Gurmukh goes to the other world.

19.g: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਿੜ ਮਲਿਆ।
19.t: sachee dharageh jai sachaa piR maliaa|
19.e: There in the true court (of the lord) they get their true place.
Repast of the Gurmukh is love and their delight is devoid of flirtatiousness.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਹਲੈ ਹਲਿਆ।
19.t: gurmukh nihachal chit na halai haliaa|
19.e: The Gurmukh has a tranquil heart and remains steadfast even in ups and downs.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਉ ਭਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਭਲਿਆ।
19.t: gurmukh sach alaau bhalee hoo(n) bhaliaa|
19.e: The Gurmukh speaks truth and good of the good.
Only Gurmukhs are called to the court of the Lord and they come to the world only when the Lord sends them.
Virtue of a Gurmukh
Gurmukh accomplishes the intractable and hence is called sadhu.
Gurmukh has such wisdom, which is competent to separate water from milk. This is why he is called wise.
The devotion of gurmukh is loving devotion.
Since the gurmukhs attain divine knowledge, they are called knowledgeable ones (jnanis).
Gurmukhs have the wisdom fully stamped and marked by the Word.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਉੜੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥੧੫॥
19.t: gurmukh pauRee pat piram ras maaneeaai ||15||
19.e: Climbing the stairs of high regards, the gurmukh enjoys the delight of love of the beloved Lord.
Gains from a gurmukh
The true name of the creator Lord is received from the gurmukhs,
Amidst the gurmukhs the Oankar Word is remembered.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ।
19.t: gurmukh sabadh veechaar sadhaa liv laieeaai|
19.e: Amid the gurmukhs the word is pondered upon and the consciousness is merged in it,
Living the truthful life of the gurmukhs, the truth is accomplished in life.
Gurmukh is that door of liberation through which one automatically enters his innate nature (the divine self).
He base of name (of the Lord) is attained from gurmukhs and one does not repent in the end.
Gains from a gurmukh
Touching the philosopher's stone in the form of a gurmukh one himself becomes the philosophers stone.
By the glimpse only of the gurmukh, all evil passions become untouchable.
Meditating upon the Lord amid the gurmukhs one loses duality.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਧਨ ਰੂਪ ਨਿੰਦ ਨ ਗੋਈਐ।
19.t: gurmukh paradhan roop ni(n)dh na goieeaai|
19.e: In the company of the gurmukhs neither the wealth and physical beauty of others is seen nor is backbiting committed.
In the company of gurmukhs only nectar-name in the form of Word is churned and the essence is acquired.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਸਦਾ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਰੋਈਐ ॥੧੭॥
19.t: gurmukh hasadhaa jai a(n)t na roieeaai ||17||
19.e: In the company of gurmukhs the jiva (self) at last becomes happy and does not wail and weep.
Nature and form of gurmukh
As a knowledgeable person, the gurmukh imparts knowledge to the world.
Losing their ego, the gurmukhs purify their inner-self.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੀਐ।
19.t: gurmukh sat sa(n)tokh na kaam karodheeaai|
19.e: Gurmukhs adopt truth and contentment and do not indulge in lust and anger.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਨ ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧੀਐ।
19.t: gurmukh hai niravair na vair virodheeaai|
19.e: Gurmukhs have no enmity and opposition towards anyone.
Preaching to all the four varnas, gurmukhs merge in equipoise.
Blest is the mother of a gurmukh who has given birth to him and the gurmukh is the best among warriors.
Carefree gurmukh
Gurmukh eulogises the wondrous Lord in the form.
Gurmukhs have true kingdom of God's praises.
Gurmukhs have armour of truth which they have been gifted by the Lord.
For gurmukhs only the beautiful highway of truth has been prepared.
Their wisdom is unfathomable and to get to it one gets perplexed.
Gurmukh is carefree in the world but not so towards the Lord.
Serious and tranquil gurmukh

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲਣਿ ਤੋਲੀਐ।
19.t: gurmukh pooraa tol na tolan toleeaai|
19.e: Gurmukh is perfect; he cannot be weighed on any scale.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਬੋਲ ਨ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਬੋਲੀਐ।
19.t: gurmukh pooraa bol na bolan boleeaai|
19.e: Every word by gurmukh comes to be true and perfect and nothing can be said about him.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਡੋਲ ਨ ਡੋਲਣਿ ਡੋਲੀਐ।
19.t: gurmukh mat addol na ddolan ddoleeaai|
19.e: The wisdom of gurmukhs is stable one and does not get destabilised even if done so.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨ ਮੋਲਣਿ ਮੋਲੀਐ।
19.t: gurmukh piram amol na molan moleeaai|
19.e: The love of gurmukhs is invaluable and it cannot be purchased at any cost.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਨਿਰੋਲੁ ਨ ਰੋਲਣਿ ਰੋਲੀਐ।
19.t: gurmukh pa(n)th nirol na rolan roleeaai|
19.e: The way of gurmukh is clear and distinct; it cannot be subsumed and dissipated by any one.

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਲੋਲੁ ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਝੋਲੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
19.t: gurmukh sabadh alol pee a(n)mrit jholeeaai ||20||
19.e: The words of gurmukhs are steadfast; along with them one quaffs nectar by deleting passions and carnal desires.
Gurmukhs remain dormant in their self

19.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਪਾਇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ।
19.t: gurmukh sukhafal pai sabh fal paiaa|
19.e: By attaining pleasure-fruit gurmukhs have received all the fruits.

19.g: ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਇ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਇਆ।
19.t: ra(n)g sura(n)g chaRhai sabh ra(n)g laiaa|
19.e: Putting on the beautiful colour of the Lord they have enjoyed the delight of all the colours.
Merging in the fragrance (of devotion) they make everyone fragrant.
They have satiated with the delight of nectar and now they feel as if they have had all the taste.
Merging their consciousness in the Word they have become one with the unstruck melody.

19.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਦਹਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੧੯॥
19.t: nij ghar nihachal jai na dhahadhis dhaiaa ||21||19||
19.e: Now they get stabilised in their inner self and their mind does not now wonder in all the ten directions.

20.e: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
God himself created the true Guru Nanak.
Becoming Sikh of the Guru, Guru Angad joined this family.

20.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ।
20.t: gursikh hai gur amar satigur bhaiaa|
20.e: Liked by the true Guru, Guru Amar Das became Sikh of the Guru.
Then Ram Das, the Sikh of the Guru came to be known as the Guru.
Thereafter came Guru Arjan as the disciple of the Guru (and got established as the Guru).
Hargobind, the Sikh of the Guru cannot remain concealed even if somebody wishes to (and this further means that all the Gurus had the same light).
All the Gurus had the same light
The Gurmukh (Guru Nanak) by becoming the philosopher's stone made all the disciples venerable.

20.g: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ।
20.t: asaT dhaat ik dhaat jot jagaiaa|
20.e: He illumined the people of all the varnas as the philosopher's stone converts all the right metals into gold.
By becoming sandalwood he made all the trees fragrant.

20.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
20.t: gursikh sikh gur hoi acharaj dhikhaiaa|
20.e: He accomplished the wonder of making disciple the Guru.
Extended his light similarly as a lamp is lit by another lamp.
As the water mixing with water becomes one, likewise deleting ego, the Sikh merges into the Guru.
The gurmukh
The life of that Gurmukh is successful who has met the true Guru.
The Gurmukh who has surrendered before the Guru is a blest one and his fate is perfect one.
The true Guru, by giving him place around his feet has made him remember the name (of the Lord).

20.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ।
20.t: ghar hee vich udhaas na viaapai maiaa|
20.e: Now being detached, he remains at home and maya does not affect him.
By putting into practice the teachings of the Guru, he has realised he invisible Lord.
Losing his ego, the Guru-orientated Gurmukh has become liberated though still embodied.
The Gurmukhs only sustain the anbearable cup of love

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
20.t: gurmukh aap gavai na aap ganaiaa|
20.e: The Gurmukhs erase their ego and never allow themselves to be noticed.
Effacing duality, they venerate only one Lord.
Accepting Guru as God they by cultivating the words of the Guru, translate them into life.
The Gurmukhs serve and attain the fruits of happiness.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
20.t: gurmukh kaar kamai sukh fal paiaa|
20.e: This way receiving the cup of love,
They bear the effect of this unbearable in their mind.
Daily routine of the Gurmukh
The Guru-orientated gets up early in the morning and makes others also to do so.
Discarding delusions is equal to bathing at the holy places for him.
Gurmukh carefully and attentively recites the moolmantar.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ।
20.t: gurmukh nihachal hoi ik man dhiaaiaa|
20.e: The Gurmukh single-mindedly concentrates upon the Lord.
The red mark of love adorns his forehead.

20.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
20.t: pairee pai gur sikh pairee paiaa ||5||
20.e: Falling on the feet of the Sikhs of the Guru and thus through his own humility, he makes others surrender to his feet.
The earning of Gurmukh
Touching the feet, the Sikhs of the Guru wash their feet.
Then they taste the ambrosial word (of Guru) through which the mind is controlled.
They fetch water, fan the sangat and put wood in the firebox of the kitchen.
They listen to, write and make others write the hymns of the Gurus.
They practice the remembrance of Lords name, charity and ablutions.

20.g: ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਮਿਠ ਬੋਲ ਘਾਲਿ ਖਵਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
20.t: niv chalan miTh bol ghaal khavaiaa ||6||
20.e: They walk in humility, speak sweetly, and eat the earning of their own hands.
Metting of the Sikhs of the Guru
The Sikhs of Guru meet the Sikhs of the Guru.
Bound by the loving devotion, they celebrate the anniversaries of the Guru.
For them, the Sikh of the Guru is the god, goddess and the father.

20.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਾਂ ਪਿਉ ਵੀਰ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਬਾਇਆ।
20.t: gursikh maa(n) piau veer kuTa(n)b sabaiaa|
20.e: Mother, father, brother and the family also is the Sikh of the Guru.
Meeting to the Sikhs of the Guru is farming business as well as other gainful occupations for the Sikh.
The progeny of the swan like Sikhs of Guru is also the Sikh of the Guru.
Omens

20.g: ਸਜਾ ਖਬਾ ਸਉਣੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
20.t: sajaa khabaa saun na ma(n)n vasaiaa|
20.e: The Gurmukhs never take to their heart the omen on the right or the left.

20.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਨੋ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਪੈਰੁ ਹਟਾਇਆ।
20.t: naar purakh no vekh na pair haTaiaa|
20.e: They do not retrace their steps while seeing a man or woman.

20.g: ਭਾਖ ਸੁਭਾਖ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਨ ਛਿਕ ਮਨਾਇਆ।
20.t: bhaakh subhaakh veechaar na chhik manaiaa|
20.e: They do not pay attention to the crises of animals or sneezing.

20.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
20.t: dhevee dhev na sev na pooj karaiaa|
20.e: Goddess and gods are neither served nor worshipped by them.
By not entangling in deceits, they do not allow their minds to wander.
The Gursikhs have sowed the seed of truth in the field of life and have made it fruitful.
Holy congregation, abode the truth

20.g: ਕਿਰਤ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
20.t: kirat virat man dharam sach dhiRaiaa|
20.e: For earning livelihood, the Gurmukhs keep in mind, the dharma and always remember the truth.
They know that the creator himself has created (and diffused) the truth.

20.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਇਆ।
20.t: satigur purakh dhiaal dhiaa kar aaiaa|
20.e: That true Guru, the supreme one, compassionately has descended on earth.
Personifying the formless into the form of Word He has recited it for one and all.
The Guru has founded the high mound of the holy congregation known also as the abode of truth.
There only establishing the true throne he has made all to bow and salute.
Services to the holy congregation
The Sikhs of the Guru inspire the Sikhs of the Guru to serve.

20.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
20.t: saadhasa(n)gat kar sev sukh fal paiaa|
20.e: Serving the holy congregation they receive the fruit of happiness.
Sweeping and spreading the sitting mats they bathe in the dust of the holy congregation.
They bring unused pitchers and fill them with water (to get it cold).
They bring sacred food (maha parshad), distribute it among others and eat.

20.g: ੧੧ : ਬੁਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਵਿਖੇ
20.t: 11 : bure naal bhalaa karan dhe vikhe
20.e: Do good to evil person
Tree is there in the world and keeps its head downward.
It stands steadfast and maintains its head low.

20.g: ਹੋਇ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲ ਸਫਲੁ ਵਟ ਸਹਾਇਆ।
20.t: hoi sufal fal safal vaT sahaiaa|
20.e: Then becoming full of fruits it bears the stone-blows.
Further it gets sawed and causes to make ship.

20.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਵਾਟ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
20.t: paanee dhe sir vaaT raahu chalaiaa|
20.e: Now it moves on the head of water.
Having borne iron-saw upon head, it carries the same iron (used in ship making) across the water.
The tree bears the evil and does the good
With the help of iron the tree is cut and pruned and iron nails are stuck into it.
But the tree carry iron on its head keeps it floating on water.

20.g: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਪਾਲਿ ਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਡੁਬਾਇਆ।
20.t: aapanaRaa put paal na neer ddubaiaa|
20.e: The water also considering it its adopted son does not make it sink.
But the sandalwood is sunk intentionally to make it costlier.

20.g: ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਇ ਜਗੁ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ।
20.t: gun keete gun hoi jag pateeaaiaa|
20.e: The quality of goodness produces goodness and the whole world also remains happy.

20.g: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਹਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
20.t: avagun seh gun karai ghol ghumaiaa ||12||
20.e: I am sacrifice unto him who does good in return of evil.
Orders of the true Guru
Who accepts the order (will) of Lord makes the whole world accept His order (Hukam).
The order of the Guru is that the will of the Lord be accepted positively.
Drinking the cup of loving devotion, they visualise the invisible (Lord).

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
20.t: gurmukh alakh lakhai na alakh lakhaiaa|
20.e: The Gurmukhs even having seen (realised) do not go on divulging this mystery.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
20.t: gurmukh aap gavai na aap ganaiaa|
20.e: Gurmukhs delete ego from the self and never allow themselves to be noticed.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ਬੀਜ ਫਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
20.t: gurmukh sukh fal pai beej falaiaa ||13||
20.e: The Guru-orientated ones acquire the fruit of happiness and spread its seeds all around.
Love of a disciple
Having the sight of the true Guru, the Sikh of the Guru concentrates upon Him.
Pondering upon the word of true Guru he cultivates knowledge.

20.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
20.t: charan kaval gur ma(n)t chit vasaiaa|
20.e: He keeps to his heart the mantra and the lotus feet of Guru.
He serves the true Guru and consequently makes the whole world serve him.
The Guru loves disciple and disciple makes the whole world happy.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
20.t: gurmukh pa(n)th chalai nij ghar chhaiaa ||14||
20.e: This way, that disciple creates a religion of the Gurmukhs and situates in his own self.
Yoga-technique for Gurmukh
Guru has explained the technique of yoga to the Sikhs.
Remain detached amidst all the hopes and cravings.
Eat less food and drink little water.

20.g: ਥੋੜਾ ਬੋਲਣ ਬੋਲ ਨ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਾਇਆ।
20.t: thoRaa bolan bol na jhakh jhakhaiaa|
20.e: Speak less and do not talk nonsensical.

20.g: ਥੋੜੀ ਰਾਤੀ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਹਾਇਆ।
20.t: thoRee raatee needh na moh fahaiaa|
20.e: Sleep less and do not be caught in any infatuation.

20.g: ਸੁਹਣੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
20.t: suhane a(n)dhar jai na lobh lubhaiaa ||15||
20.e: Sleep less and do not be caught in any infatuation.
Yoga-technique for Gursikhs
The sermon of the Guru is the earrings of a yogi.

20.g: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਸਿਵਾਇ ਝੋਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ।
20.t: khi(n)thaa khimaa sivai jholee pat maiaa|
20.e: Forgiveness is the patched blanket and in the beggar's bad is the name of the Lord of maya (God).
Humbly touching of the feet ashes.
Cup of love is the bowl, which is filled with the food of affection.
Knowledge is the staff with which the messengers of different propensities of mind are cultured.
Holy congregation is the tranquil cave wherein the yogi resides in equipoise.
Other means of yoga-technique for  Gursikhs
The knowledge about the supreme is the trumpet (singi) of yogi and the recitation of the word is its playing upon.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਈ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਆਇਆ।
20.t: gurmukh aaiee pa(n)th nij ghar aaiaa|
20.e: The best assembly of gurmukhs i.e. the Ai panth, could be attained by settling in one's own home.
Such people (Gurmukhs) bow before the primal Lord and have the sight of the invisible (God).
The disciples and the Gurus have enrapt themselves in the mutual love for one another.
Getting above of the worldly affairs, they meet (their ultimate destiny) the Lord.
World, the game of dice

20.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਿਖ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
20.t: gur sikh sun gursikh sikh sadhaiaa|
20.e: Having listened to the teaching of Guru,
The Sikh of Guru has called other Sikhs.

20.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
20.t: gursikh sun kar bhaau ma(n)n vasaiaa|
20.e: Adopting the teachings of the Guru,
The Sikh has recited the same to others.
The Sikhs of the Guru have liked the Sikhs and thus a Sikh has met the Sikhs.

20.g: ਚਉਪੜਿ ਸੋਲਹ ਸਾਰ ਜੁਗ ਜਿਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
20.t: chaupaR soleh saar jug jin aaiaa ||18||
20.e: The pair of the Guru and the disciple has conquered the world-game of oblong dice.
The game of chess
The chess players have spread the chess mat.
Elephants, chariots, horses and pedestrians have been brought in.

20.g: ਹੁਇ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਵਜੀਰ ਦੁਇ ਦਲ ਛਾਇਆ।
20.t: hui patisaahu vajeer dhui dhal chhaiaa|
20.e: The groups of kings and ministers have gathered and are fighting tooth and nail.
The groups of kings and ministers have gathered and are fighting tooth and nail.
The Gurmukh by making a move has opened his heart before the Guru.
The Guru has lifted pedestrian to the rank of minister and has placed him in the palace of success (and thus has saved the life game of the disciple).
Living in the fear of God, Gurmukhs attain formless God

20.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਮਣਿ ਨਿਮਿ ਭੈ ਵਿਚ ਜਾਇਆ।
20.t: bhai vich niman nim bhai vich jaiaa|
20.e: Under the natural law (fear of lord), the jiva (creature) is conceived (by mother) and in the fear (law) he is born.

20.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ।
20.t: bhai vich gurmukh pa(n)th saranee aaiaa|
20.e: In fear he comes in the shelter of the way (panth) of Guru.

20.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ।
20.t: bhai vich sa(n)gat saadh sabadh kamaiaa|
20.e: In fear while in the holy congregation he earns the merit of the True Word

20.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ।
20.t: bhai vich jeevan mukat bhaanaa bhaiaa|
20.e: In fear (natural laws) he gets liberated in life and accepts the will of God happily.

20.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
20.t: bhai vich janam savaar sahaj samaiaa|
20.e: In fear he leaves away this life and merges in equipoise.

20.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੦॥
20.t: bhai vich nij ghar jai pooraa paiaa ||20||
20.e: In fear he settles in his self and attains the supreme Perfect Being.
In praise of the Guru
Those who, accepting Guru as God have sought shelter in the Lord.

20.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
20.t: gur charanee chit lai na chalai chalaiaa|
20.e: Those who have put their heart at the feet of Lord, never become perishable.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਜ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
20.t: gurmat nihachal hoi nij padh paiaa|
20.e: They, getting deeply rooted in the wisdom of Guru, attain themselves.
They adopt the daily routine of the Gurmukhs, and Gods Will becomes dear to them.
As Gurmukhs, losing their ego, they merge in the truth.

20.g: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੨੦।
20.t: safal janam jag aai jagat taraiaa ||21||20|
20.e: Their birth in the world is meaningful and they across the whole world also.
